Furthermore, we demonstrate the usefulness of EgoContact's annotated interactions for robotic manipulation: simply using EgoContact as the memory bank of an existing affordance-transfer policy improves grasp success from 14.2% to 31.2% in simulation and from 16% to 58% on a real robot.
tldr: EgoContact is a large-scale egocentric video dataset of 22.5K interaction events for evaluating physical intelligence via future contact-point prediction, and it improves grasp success when used as a memory bank for affordance-transfer policies.
tldr_zh: EgoContact是一个包含2.25万个交互事件的大规模第一视角视频数据集，通过未来接触点预测来评估物理智能，并作为记忆库将抓取成功率从14.2%提升至31.2%（仿真）和从16%提升至58%（真机）。
summary_zh: 以自我为中心的视频已成为学习可泛化操作先验知识的最具可扩展性的数据来源之一。然而，尽管其在机器人策略预训练中的应用日益广泛，它作为物理智能验证工具的潜力仍未被充分利用——而物理智能的一个关键组成部分是理解应在物体的何处进行接触以实现预期交互。我们提出了EgoContact，一个大规模以自我为中心的数据集，用于通过未来接触点预测来评估所学操作先验的泛化性和精确性。EgoContact包含22.5K个经人工验证的交互事件，每个事件包含接触前观察、语义意图和像素级精确的接触位置。我们发现，当前方法往往难以预测精确的交互接触点，有时甚至无法在多样化的真实场景中定位目标物体，即使允许进行多次预测也是如此。此外，我们展示了EgoContact的标注交互数据在机器人操作中的实用性：仅将EgoContact用作现有可供性迁移策略的记忆库，即可将仿真中的抓取成功率从14.2%提升至31.2%，在真实机器人上从16%提升至58%。

title: Tracking Task Progress Through Errors and Recovery:A Benchmark and Recurrent Distributional Model
summary: Operational strategies for long-horizon robotic tasks require reliable evaluation to determine whether execution is progressing, stalling, regressing, or recovering from errors. Yet real- world robot datasets that capture error recovery and provide frame-level error annotations remain scarce. To address this gap, we introduce and open-source ReSTEP, a dataset of 3,156 episodes across two manipulation tasks with semantic stage labels and frame-level er- ror annotations. ReSTEP supports training and benchmarking progress monitors through successful execution, mistakes, and recovery. Existing progress estimators can struggle to distinguish visually similar task stages and maintain temporally consistent predictions while responding to genuine setbacks. We therefore propose REMORA, an online progress esti- mator that combines recurrent visual memory, distributional prediction, and causal peak selection. Memory retains execution history to help resolve visual ambiguity, while distribu- tional prediction represents alternative progress hypotheses and causal peak selection tracks a supported hypothesis over time. Together, these components enable consistent progress tracking that remains responsive to errors and recovery. Experiments on both ReSTEP tasks demonstrate that REMORA outperforms the state-of-the-art SARM baseline in progress ac- curacy and temporal consistency.
tldr: The paper introduces ReSTEP, a benchmark dataset of 3,156 manipulation episodes with semantic stage labels and frame-level error annotations, and proposes REMORA, an online progress estimator combining recurrent visual memory, distributional prediction, and causal peak selection for tracking task progress and error recovery.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了ReSTEP——一个包含3156个操作任务回合、带有语义阶段标签和帧级错误标注的基准数据集，并提出REMORA——一种结合循环视觉记忆、分布预测和因果峰值选择的在线进度估计器，用于跟踪任务进度和错误恢复。
summary_zh: 长时程机器人任务的执行策略需要可靠的评估，以判断执行是在推进、停滞、倒退，还是正在从错误中恢复。然而，能够捕捉错误恢复并提供帧级错误标注的真实世界机器人数据集仍然稀缺。为弥补这一空白，我们引入并开源了ReSTEP，这是一个包含两个操作任务、共3，156个回合的数据集，带有语义阶段标签和帧级错误标注。ReSTEP支持通过成功执行、错误和恢复来训练和基准测试进度监控器。现有的进度估计器可能难以区分视觉上相似的任务阶段，也难以在响应真实挫折的同时保持时间上一致的预测。因此，我们提出了REMORA，一种在线进度估计器，它结合了循环视觉记忆、分布预测和因果峰值选择。记忆保留执行历史，以帮助解决视觉歧义；分布预测表示替代的进度假设；因果峰值选择则随时间跟踪一个受到支持的假设。这些组件共同实现了持续的进度跟踪，并对错误和恢复保持响应。在两个ReSTEP任务上的实验表明，REMORA在进度准确性和时间一致性方面优于最先进的SARM基线。

title: Tactus: Tactile & Pose Sensing Glove for Natural Dexterity Data Collection
summary: Collecting naturalistic human manipulation demonstrations with accurate contact force and hand pose is essential for robot dexterous manipulation policy and foundational world model learning - yet no existing wearable platform provides both calibrated fingertip force sensing and occlusion-resilient hand tracking in a form factor that preserves natural manipulation behavior. We present Tactus, a textile-integrated sensing glove that co-optimizes three design pillars: (1) a thin, conformal 3D-knit form factor (1.5 mm fingertip stackup) designed to minimize interference with natural manipulation, (2) strategically placed capacitive tactile sensors at manipulation-relevant regions informed by empirical contact studies, and (3) IMU-fused pose tracking that maintains accuracy through the hand-object occlusions where manipulation data is most valuable. Tactus includes a documented calibration pipeline for cross-glove consistency and per-session calibration for subject-dependent correction. To enable objective comparison, we introduce standardized benchmarking protocols for tactile force regression and hand pose estimation, and apply them to Tactus and two commercially available tactile gloves - to our knowledge the first quantitative cross-platform evaluation of this kind. Tactus resolves a minimum detectable force of 0.59 N at 95% confidence, 1.6 - 2.7x lower than the commercial baselines, and with 0.87 cross-participant consistency, while our pose tracking sustains 11.0 mm fingertip keypoint relative error during manipulation, when occlusion is heaviest. We show that these combined signals support object property estimation, slip detection, and representative recording of hand-object interaction - yielding demonstration data with the fidelity required for contact-aware manipulation policies and world models.
tldr: Tactus is a sensing glove that integrates capacitive fingertip force sensors and IMU-fused pose tracking in a thin 3D-knit form factor, enabling naturalistic collection of calibrated hand-object interaction data for dexterous manipulation policy and world model learning.
tldr_zh: Tactus是一款传感手套，将电容式指尖力传感器与IMU融合的姿态追踪集成在1.5毫米厚的3D针织形态中，以自然方式收集校准的手物交互数据，用于灵巧操作策略和世界模型学习。
summary_zh: 收集带有精确接触力和手部姿态的自然人类操作演示，对于机器人灵巧操作策略和基础世界模型学习至关重要——然而，现有的可穿戴平台均无法在以保持自然操作行为的外形条件下，同时提供校准的指尖力传感和抗遮挡的手部追踪功能。我们提出了Tactus，一种纺织集成传感手套，协同优化了三大设计支柱：（1）薄型、贴合的3D针织外形（指尖堆叠厚度1.5 mm），旨在最大程度减少对自然操作的干扰；（2）基于经验接触研究，在操作相关区域策略性布置电容式触觉传感器；（3）融合惯性测量单元（IMU）的姿态追踪，在手-物遮挡最严重——即操作数据最具价值时——仍能保持追踪精度。Tactus配备了文档化的校准流程，以实现跨手套一致性，并提供按次会话校准以进行受试者差异修正。为支持客观对比，我们引入了触觉力回归和手部姿态估计的标准化基准测试协议，并将其应用于Tactus及两款商用触觉手套——据我们所知，这是此类首次定量跨平台评估。Tactus在95%置信水平下可分辨的最小力为0.59 N，比商用基线低1.6至2.7倍，跨受试者一致性达0.87；同时，在遮挡最严重的操作过程中，我们的姿态追踪将指尖关键点相对误差维持在11.0 mm。我们证明，这些组合信号能够支持物体属性估计、滑动检测以及手-物交互的代表性记录——从而生成具有接触感知操作策略和世界模型所需保真度的演示数据。

title: Catch It All!: Generalizable Dynamic Catching with a Dexterous Hand
summary: Catching arbitrary objects requires generalization to novel projectiles and real-time adaptation to unpredictable contact dynamics under noisy visual observations. This paper presents Catch It All!, a sim-to-real catching framework for humanoid robots that generalizes and adapts to unseen objects with variable physical properties for underhand and overhand catches, using only one egocentric camera. We learn policies which generalize to unseen objects with varying geometry, deformability, elasticity, and physical properties. Effective grasps which adapt real-time to object poses and shapes are learned through careful grasp reward design. We provide safety-aware curricula which enable safe, high-frequency action execution near hardware limits, including wrist torque limits as low as 5 Nm. We validate our system by deploying zero-shot on a Unitree G1. With only one egocentric camera, Catch It All! successfully performs underhand and overhand catches on 9 unseen objects not seen during training, including low-rebound plushes, semi-deformable toys and chip bags, and rigid-elastic objects with high rebound on contact.
tldr: This paper introduces a sim-to-real framework for humanoid robots to catch arbitrary unseen objects with a dexterous hand using only egocentric vision, demonstrating zero-shot deployment on a Unitree G1.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种用于人形机器人的sim-to-real抓取框架，仅使用单目相机即可灵巧手动态抓取未见过的物体，并在Unitree G1上实现了零样本部署。
summary_zh: 摘要：捕捉任意物体要求对新投射物具备泛化能力，并在视觉观测含噪声的情况下，对不可预测的接触动力学进行实时适应。本文提出了Catch It All!——一个面向人形机器人的仿真到现实抓取框架，该框架仅使用一个第一视角摄像头，即可针对下手接物和上手接物两种方式，泛化并适应具有不同物理属性的未见物体。我们学习到的策略能够泛化至具有不同几何形状、可变形性、弹性和物理属性的未见物体。通过精心设计的抓取奖励机制，我们学习到了能够实时适应物体姿态和形状的有效抓取策略。我们提供了考虑安全性的课程设置，使系统能在接近硬件极限的情况下进行安全、高频的动作执行，包括低至5牛米的腕部扭矩限制。我们通过在Unitree G1机器人上进行零样本部署来验证该系统。仅凭一个第一视角摄像头，Catch It All!成功完成了对9种训练时未见物体的下手和上手接取，这些物体包括低回弹的毛绒玩具、半可变形玩具、薯片袋，以及接触时高回弹的刚性弹性物体。

title: AtomTree: A Hierarchical Framework for State-Aware Embodied Instruction Following with LLMs
summary: Embodied instruction following in interactive environments requires agents to interpret natural language commands and complete long-horizon tasks. Existing planners either rely on large labeled trajectories, or use few-shot and zero-shot LLM prompting that produces a whole plan in a single serial reasoning process. These approaches depend on linguistic common sense, commit to a plan from the initial instruction, and only update after failures, which weakens robustness and state awareness. We present AtomTree, a hierarchical framework for state-aware task planning with LLMs. AtomTree incrementally builds a tree of subgoals and actions, where the LLM decides at each step, from the current symbolic state, whether to further decompose or to output a grounded low-level action. A lightweight memory module summarizes past outcomes for reuse in later decisions. When a low-level action stalls, AtomTree triggers hierarchical backtracking replanning to return to the parent node and regenerate the subtree plan from the latest state, preventing continued drift along an incorrect trajectory. In zero-shot evaluation on the ALFRED benchmark, AtomTree outperforms prior LLM-based planners. Project page: https://zhaihaotian.github.io/atomtree-website/.
tldr: AtomTree is a hierarchical LLM-based planner for embodied instruction following that incrementally builds a subgoal tree, uses a memory module for state awareness, and triggers hierarchical backtracking replanning when actions stall, achieving SOTA zero-shot performance on ALFRED.
tldr_zh: AtomTree 是一种基于LLM的分层规划框架，用于具身指令跟随，通过逐步构建子目标树、记忆模块实现状态感知，并在动作停滞时触发层级回溯重规划，在ALFRED零样本评测中取得最优结果。
summary_zh: 在交互式环境中执行具身指令跟随任务，要求智能体能够理解自然语言指令并完成长时程任务。现有规划器要么依赖大规模标注轨迹，要么采用少样本或零样本的大语言模型提示方式，在单一串行推理过程中生成完整计划。这些方法依赖语言常识，从初始指令即确定整体计划，仅在失败后更新，因而鲁棒性和状态感知能力较弱。我们提出AtomTree，一个面向状态感知任务规划的层次化大语言模型框架。AtomTree逐步构建子目标与动作的树结构，在每一步中，大语言模型基于当前符号状态决定是进一步分解子目标，还是输出可执行的低层动作。轻量级记忆模块汇总历史结果，供后续决策复用。当低层动作受阻时，AtomTree触发层次化回溯重规划，返回父节点并从最新状态重新生成子树计划，从而避免沿错误轨迹持续漂移。在ALFRED基准上的零样本评估中，AtomTree优于此前基于大语言模型的规划器。项目主页：https://zhaihaotian.github.io/atomtree-website/。

title: Quantize by Doing: Task-Guided Mixed-Precision Quantization of Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Post-training quantization (PTQ) reduces the memory footprint of vision-language-action (VLA) models, but lowering bit widths while maintaining task performance remains challenging. Existing work has used sensitivity estimates from calibration data to assign bit widths to different model components. However, using task success directly to guide mixed-precision allocation is underexplored because closed-loop evaluations are costly and the effect of quantizing one component depends on the precision of other components. To this end, we propose \textbf{QbD-VLA}, a task-guided mixed-precision quantization method that uses task success from short closed-loop evaluations to assign weight and activation bit widths while accounting for interactions between model components. Experiments covering four VLA models and all four LIBERO suites show strong task performance at average precisions of approximately 4 bits for weights and fewer than 6 bits for activations. On SIMPLER, the gain over uniform quantization is small. On a Franka Research 3 robot arm, simulation-selected allocations show no detected success-rate loss on X-VLA but fail on $π_{0.5}$. These findings support using task success to guide mixed-precision VLA quantization, while highlighting the need for real-world evaluation before deployment. Code is available at \href{https://github.com/jiuyixu25/QbD-VLA}{\texttt{github.com/jiuyixu25/QbD-VLA}}.
tldr: This paper proposes QbD-VLA, a task-guided mixed-precision quantization method for vision-language-action models that uses closed-loop task success to assign bit widths, demonstrating strong performance in simulation but mixed results in real-world deployment.
tldr_zh: 本文提出QbD-VLA，一种任务引导的混合精度量化方法，利用闭环任务成功率来分配视觉-语言-动作模型的位宽，在仿真中表现出色，但在真实世界部署中结果不一。
summary_zh: 训练后量化（PTQ）降低了视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的内存占用，但在保持任务性能的同时降低位宽仍然具有挑战性。现有工作利用校准数据的敏感度估计为不同模型组件分配位宽。然而，直接使用任务成功率来指导混合精度分配的研究仍不充分，因为闭环评估成本高昂，且量化某一组件的效果取决于其他组件的精度。为此，我们提出了QbD-VLA，一种任务引导的混合精度量化方法，利用短闭环评估中的任务成功率来分配权重和激活位宽，同时考虑模型组件之间的交互影响。覆盖四种VLA模型和全部四个LIBERO套件的实验表明，在权重平均精度约4比特、激活少于6比特的条件下，方法仍能保持较强的任务性能。在SIMPLER上，相对于均匀量化的增益较小。在Franka Research 3机械臂上，仿真选择的分配方案在X-VLA上未检测到成功率损失，但在π_{0.5}上失败。这些发现支持使用任务成功率来指导混合精度VLA量化，同时强调了部署前进行真实世界评估的必要性。代码可在\href{https://github.com/jiuyixu25/QbD-VLA}{\texttt{github.com/jiuyixu25/QbD-VLA}}获取。

title: Generating Critic-Guided Synthetic Experience in Latent World Models
summary: Learning from offline datasets is limited in scalability, as collecting new experience is often costly or unsafe in the real world. World models offer an alternative way to generate new experience through a learned dynamics model, yet learning policies in latent space is limited due to compounding errors in imagined rollouts. To this end, we propose using the world model as a local transition generator, leveraging critic guidance to choose actions inside that model to generate synthetic experiences. We study action refinement methodologies, introducing Critic-Guided Synthetic Experience (CGSE) generation in world models. Specifically, CGSE augments an existing offline dataset by sampling candidate actions using an offline policy and refining each to maximize a first-order approximation of the $Q$-function within a trust region. We then use a frozen latent world model to imagine the future state given each updated action, and use the critic to choose the best one, appending this synthetic transition to the replay buffer. Our method requires no additional real-environment interaction or test-time planner, as it generates synthetic experience offline using the world model. On three OGBench manipulation tasks, CGSE improves an offline policy by a relative improvement of $7.1\%$ on the average success rate.
tldr: This paper introduces Critic-Guided Synthetic Experience (CGSE), a method that uses a frozen latent world model and critic-guided action refinement to generate synthetic transitions from offline data, improving offline RL policies on manipulation tasks without real-world interaction.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种批评者引导的合成经验生成方法（CGSE），利用冻结的潜在世界模型和批评者引导的动作优化，从离线数据生成合成转换，无需真实环境交互即可提升操作任务的离线策略性能。
summary_zh: 从离线数据集中学习在可扩展性方面受到限制，因为在现实世界中收集新经验往往代价高昂或存在安全风险。世界模型提供了一种通过学习到的动力学模型生成新经验的替代方式，然而在潜在空间中学习策略会因想象轨迹中的复合误差而受到限制。为此，我们提出将世界模型用作局部转移生成器，利用评论家引导在该模型内部选择动作以生成合成经验。我们研究了动作细化方法，引入了世界模型中的评论家引导合成经验（CGSE）生成机制。具体而言，CGSE通过使用离线策略采样候选动作，并在信任区域内最大化$Q$函数的一阶近似来细化每个动作，从而增强现有的离线数据集。随后，我们使用冻结的潜在世界模型根据每个更新后的动作想象未来状态，并利用评论家选择最优者，将这一合成转移添加到经验回放缓冲区中。我们的方法无需额外的真实环境交互或测试时的规划器，因为它利用世界模型在离线状态下生成合成经验。在三个OGBench操作任务中，CGSE将离线策略的平均成功率相对提升了$7.1\%$。

title: L3G-World: Real-Time Infinite World Generation with Latent 3D Gaussian Memory
summary: Interactive world models generate visual content conditioned on user actions, yet maintaining spatial consistency over long-horizon exploration in real time remains challenging. Existing approaches rely on either temporal context or explicit 3D memory, both of which scale poorly because memory grows with the length of the generated stream. Moreover, explicit 3D memories condition latent video generators by re-encoding RGB renderings, which precludes real-time generation. In this paper, we introduce a Latent 3D Gaussian Memory (L3G) that combines the efficiency of feed-forward reconstruction with a compact, rapidly renderable scene representation. Building on this memory, we propose L3G-World, in which a memory updater and a video diffusion transformer (DiT) alternate autoregressively to generate spatially consistent worlds. The memory updater spawns Gaussians in newly observed regions and refines existing ones, so that the memory grows with scene extent rather than stream length. Each Gaussian further stores a VAE latent feature, allowing the memory to be rendered directly into the DiT's latent space without VAE re-encoding. Experiments show that L3G-World achieves state-of-the-art generation quality and long-horizon spatial consistency, with up to $38.6\times$ fewer 3D primitives, $3.2\times$ faster memory updates, and $359\times$ faster memory rendering relative to the most efficient prior 3D-memory baseline for each metric, enabling real-time world generation at 9 FPS.
tldr: This paper introduces L3G-World, a real-time interactive world generation framework that uses a latent 3D Gaussian memory to maintain spatial consistency over long-horizon exploration. The memory scales with scene extent rather than stream length and directly renders into the latent space of a video diffusion transformer, achieving state-of-the-art quality and efficiency.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了 L3G-World，一种实时交互式世界生成框架，利用潜在3D高斯记忆在长时程探索中保持空间一致性。记忆大小随场景范围而非流长度增长，并能直接渲染到视频扩散Transformer的潜在空间中，实现了最先进的生成质量和效率。
summary_zh: 交互式世界模型根据用户动作生成视觉内容，但在实时长时间探索中保持空间一致性仍然是一项挑战。现有方法依赖时间上下文或显式3D记忆，两者均因记忆随生成流长度增长而扩展性不佳。此外，显式3D记忆通过重新编码RGB渲染图来条件化潜在视频生成器，这阻碍了实时生成。本文提出了一种潜在3D高斯记忆（L3G），将前馈重建的效率与紧凑、可快速渲染的场景表示相结合。基于此记忆，我们提出了L3G-World，其中记忆更新器和视频扩散变换器（DiT）交替自回归生成空间一致的世界。记忆更新器在新观察区域生成高斯体并细化已有高斯体，使记忆随场景范围增长而非流长度增长。每个高斯体还存储一个VAE潜在特征，使记忆可直接渲染到DiT的潜在空间中，无需VAE重新编码。实验表明，L3G-World在生成质量和长期空间一致性方面达到最先进水平，与最高效的先前3D记忆基线相比，3D图元减少高达$38.6\times$，记忆更新速度快$3.2\times$，记忆渲染速度快$359\times$，实现了9 FPS的实时世界生成。

title: A Unified Benchmark for Aerial-Enhanced Autonomous Driving: The KITScenes Aerial Dataset
summary: Aerial imagery provides complementary spatial context for autonomous driving by exposing road structure beyond the immediate perception range of onboard sensors. Yet map construction from aerial imagery, aerial-assisted online HD mapping, and cross-view localization are typically studied on separate data and benchmarks. We introduce KITScenes Aerial, an extension of the KITScenes Multimodal dataset that augments synchronized onboard sensor data, vehicle poses, and rich Lanelet2 map annotations with spatially associated aerial imagery and higher-resolution neural representations, providing a common basis for a variety of research tasks. Our mapping evaluation focuses on all 53 KITScenes map classes across different model designs, spatial ranges, and aerial resolutions, while retaining compatibility with the widely used three-class setting. Representative baselines show that aerial context is particularly beneficial for fine-grained and extended-range mapping, more than doubling 53-class mAP at the larger mapping extent. Higher-resolution aerial imagery yields a further 4.3 mAP (+24 %) improvement, with gains extending to challenging map elements such as traffic lights. We additionally evaluate cross-view localization under geographically disjoint conditions, where an adapted fine-grained feature-matching baseline achieves a mean translation error of 5.13 m. KITScenes Aerial thus enables unified study of aerial and ground-level information across complementary mapping and localization tasks. Project page: https://kitscenes.com/aerial
tldr: KITScenes Aerial is a new benchmark extending KITScenes with aerial imagery and neural representations, enabling unified evaluation of aerial-assisted HD mapping and cross-view localization for autonomous driving.
tldr_zh: KITScenes Aerial 是一个新基准，通过添加航拍图像和神经表示扩展了 KITScenes，为自动驾驶中的航拍辅助高清建图和跨视角定位提供统一评估。
summary_zh: 航空影像通过揭示车载传感器即时感知范围之外的道路结构，为自动驾驶提供了互补的空间上下文信息。然而，基于航空影像的地图构建、航空辅助在线高清地图生成以及跨视角定位通常是在各自独立的数据集和基准上分别研究的。我们推出了KITScenes Aerial，这是KITScenes多模态数据集的扩展版本，在同步的车载传感器数据、车辆位姿和丰富的Lanelet2地图标注基础上，增加了空间关联的航空影像和更高分辨率的神经表示，为多种研究任务提供了统一的基础。我们的地图评估聚焦于全部53个KITScenes地图类别，覆盖不同的模型设计、空间范围和航空影像分辨率，同时保持与广泛使用的三类设置相兼容。代表性基线实验表明，航空上下文信息在细粒度和扩展范围地图构建中尤为有效，在更大地图范围下，53类mAP提升了超过一倍。更高分辨率的航空影像进一步带来了4.3 mAP（+24%）的提升，且收益延伸至交通信号灯等具有挑战性的地图要素。我们还在地理不相交的条件下评估了跨视角定位，其中经过适配的细粒度特征匹配基线实现了5.13米的平均平移误差。因此，KITScenes Aerial能够在互补的地图构建和定位任务中对航空与地面信息进行统一研究。项目主页：https://kitscenes.com/aerial

title: world2vec: Mechanistic world models through latent dynamics learning
summary: World models can achieve strong control performance without faithfully capturing the dynamics of their environment, limiting their potential for mechanistic interpretability and scientific discovery. Here, we introduce world2vec to learn mechanistic world models without reward information directly from observations and actions. World2vec learns latent dynamics that faithfully reproduce the true system over long prediction horizons, with at least one order of magnitude fewer parameters than DreamerV3, TD-MPC2 and LeWM. This enables state of the art performance in controlling continuous environments from pixels and accurate system identification across a benchmark of 71 attractors, demonstrating how world models are amenable to scientific discovery.
tldr: world2vec learns mechanistic world models from observations and actions without reward, achieving state-of-the-art control performance in continuous environments and accurate system identification with significantly fewer parameters than existing methods.
tldr_zh: world2vec在无需奖励信息的情况下，直接从观测和动作中学习机械论世界模型，以显著更少的参数实现了连续环境中的最先进控制性能和准确的系统识别。
summary_zh: 世界模型能够在未忠实捕捉其环境动力学的情况下实现强大的控制性能，这限制了其在机制可解释性和科学发现方面的潜力。在此，我们提出world2vec，直接从观测和动作中学习机制世界模型，无需奖励信息。World2vec学习到的潜在动力学能够在长预测视野上忠实再现真实系统，且参数量比DreamerV3、TD-MPC2和LeWM至少少一个数量级。这使得其能够从像素控制连续环境并达到最先进性能，同时在包含71个吸引子的基准测试中实现准确的系统辨识，展示了世界模型如何适用于科学发现。

title: Gym-Anything for Robotics: Scaling physical simulations with digital agents
summary: Realistic, fast robotics simulations could enable large-scale training of embodied AI models that transfer to the real world. However, despite decades of progress, available simulations cover only a narrow range of real-world tasks and physical phenomena. The core bottleneck is that creating better simulations requires significant expert effort and therefore does not scale. To address this, we introduce Gym-Anything for Robotics, a framework in which coding agents create realistic robotics simulations. Our core insight is that simulation creation is a coding agent task, so improvements in coding agents translate directly into richer and more faithful simulations. We select simulations based on U.S. GDP data to cover economically valuable physical work, define what makes a good simulation and a good task, and develop an adversarial creation-audit loop that checks each simulation and task against these definitions. Using this pipeline, we build RoboWorld, a set of 25 simulations with 25 test and 175 training RL environments of varying difficulty. Even the best frontier models fail on every RoboWorld test task, achieving an average reward of only 0.06. Building on RoboWorld, we introduce several new ways for frontier models to improve, including in-context learning across repeated attempts, a privileged teacher that reads the simulator state and teaches a student in context, self-assisted learning from the model's own privileged experience, and code policies that generate demonstrations across varied scenes to train vision-language-action models (VLAs) such as $π_{0.5}$. Each of these substantially improves performance. We release our pipeline, RL environments, and benchmark to facilitate future research. Code and data are available at https://gym-anything.github.io/robotics
tldr: Gym-Anything for Robotics uses coding agents to automatically create realistic robotics simulations, building RoboWorld with 25 test and 175 training RL environments, and shows that frontier models can improve via in-context learning, privileged teachers, self-assisted learning, and code policies to train vision-language-action models.
tldr_zh: Gym-Anything for Robotics 利用编码代理自动创建逼真的机器人仿真，构建了包含25个测试和175个训练RL环境的RoboWorld，并展示了前沿模型可通过上下文学习、特权教师、自我辅助学习和代码策略来训练视觉-语言-动作模型。
summary_zh: 逼真、快速的机器人仿真可以支持具身AI模型的大规模训练，并使其迁移到现实世界。然而，尽管经过数十年的进展，现有仿真仅覆盖了现实世界任务和物理现象中的一小部分。核心瓶颈在于，创建更好的仿真需要大量专家投入，因此难以规模化。为解决这一问题，我们提出了Gym-Anything for Robotics，一个由编码智能体创建逼真机器人仿真的框架。我们的核心洞见是，仿真创建是一项编码智能体任务，因此编码智能体的改进会直接转化为更丰富、更忠实的仿真。我们根据美国GDP数据选择仿真，以覆盖具有经济价值的物理工作，定义了什么构成好的仿真和好的任务，并开发了一个对抗式创建-审计循环，依据这些定义检查每个仿真和任务。利用这一流程，我们构建了RoboWorld，这是一组包含25个仿真、25个测试环境和175个不同难度训练RL环境的集合。即使是最好的前沿模型也在每个RoboWorld测试任务上失败，平均奖励仅为0.06。基于RoboWorld，我们引入了若干新方法以提升前沿模型表现，包括在重复尝试中进行上下文学习、一个读取模拟器状态并在上下文中教授学生的特权教师、利用模型自身特权经验进行自辅助学习，以及生成跨多样场景演示以训练视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA，如$π_{0.5}$）的代码策略。上述每种方法都显著提升了性能。我们发布了我们的流程、RL环境和基准，以促进未来研究。代码和数据可在https://gym-anything.github.io/robotics获取。

title: A Tutorial on Shape Servoing of Deformable Objects-Part I: Fundamentals
summary: In robotics, shape control (or shape servoing) refers to the automatic manipulation of a deformable object to achieve a desired shape. It involves a feedback loop that exploits the relation between robot motion and changes in the measured shape. This relation, known as the interaction Jacobian or, in this context, the deformation Jacobian, depends on the object's mechanical properties, geometry, and boundary conditions (e.g., where the object is grasped). Because these factors are often difficult to model accurately, the deformation Jacobian can be estimated locally from observed shape changes produced by commanded robot motions, without requiring a fine-tuned mechanical model. This article is the first of a two-part tutorial on data-driven Jacobian-based shape control of deformable objects. It introduces the central elements of the approach: the formulation of the shape-control problem, shape representation, estimation and online update of the deformation Jacobian, and a standard control law from the literature. It then assembles these elements into a complete shape-servoing loop, derives a local stability condition for this loop, and illustrates why some target shapes cannot be reached. Part II covers more advanced topics. Throughout both parts, a simulated planar example in which two robot arms manipulate an elastic rod observed by a camera illustrates the concepts.
tldr: This tutorial presents the fundamentals of data-driven Jacobian-based shape servoing for deformable objects, covering problem formulation, shape representation, Jacobian estimation, control laws, and stability analysis in a simulated dual-arm planar manipulation scenario.
tldr_zh: 本教程介绍基于数据驱动雅可比矩阵的变形物体形状伺服控制的基础知识，涵盖问题表述、形状表示、雅可比估计、控制律及稳定性分析，并在双机械臂平面操作仿真中加以说明。
summary_zh: 在机器人学中，形状控制（或称形状伺服）是指自动操纵可变形物体以达到期望形状。它涉及一个反馈回路，该回路利用机器人运动与测量形状变化之间的关系。这种关系被称为交互雅可比矩阵，在此语境下也称为变形雅可比矩阵，它取决于物体的力学特性、几何形状以及边界条件（例如物体被夹持的位置）。由于这些因素通常难以精确建模，变形雅可比矩阵可以从指令机器人运动所产生的观测形状变化中进行局部估计，而无需精细调节的力学模型。本文是关于可变形物体数据驱动雅可比矩阵形状控制的两部分教程中的第一部分。文章介绍了该方法的核心要素：形状控制问题的表述、形状表示、变形雅可比矩阵的估计与在线更新，以及文献中的一种标准控制律。随后将这些要素组合成一个完整的形状伺服回路，推导该回路的局部稳定性条件，并说明为何某些目标形状无法达到。第二部分涵盖更高级的主题。在两部分中，均通过一个仿真平面示例来阐明相关概念，其中两个机械臂操纵一根由相机观测的弹性杆。

title: A Two-Wheeled Quadrotor with All-Clockwise Tilted Rotors for Level-Attitude Surface Locomotnion
summary: Conventional wheel-equipped quadrotor UAVs must tilt their bodies to generate lateral forces, limiting their ability to maintain a desired attitude during lateral motion. This paper proposes a wheeled quadrotor with all-clockwise tilted rotors that uses surface contact as a constraint to generate propulsion along the contact surface without tilting the vehicle. We analyze feasible forces and system controllability under surface contact and optimize the vehicle design considering different rotor-spin configurations. The optimization results show that a configuration in which all four rotors spin clockwise can generate a larger tangential force than the conventional alternating-spin configuration. This approach enables both aerial and contact-based locomotion without additional rotor-tilting actuators or mechanisms. Simulation results demonstrate both hovering in free space and horizontal locomotion on a floor while maintaining a level attitude.
tldr: This paper presents a wheeled quadrotor with all-clockwise tilted rotors that can maintain a level attitude while performing horizontal locomotion on surfaces, using surface contact for propulsion and analyzed via optimization and simulation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种全顺时针倾斜旋翼的轮式四旋翼，利用地面接触产生推进力，在保持水平姿态的同时实现地面水平移动，并通过优化和仿真验证。
summary_zh: 常规配备轮子的四旋翼无人机必须倾斜机身以产生侧向力，这限制了其在侧向运动中保持期望姿态的能力。本文提出了一种所有旋翼均顺时针倾斜的轮式四旋翼无人机，利用表面接触作为约束，在不倾斜机身的情况下沿接触表面产生推进力。我们分析了表面接触条件下的可行力与系统可控性，并考虑不同旋翼旋转配置对飞行器设计进行了优化。优化结果表明，四个旋翼均顺时针旋转的配置相比传统的交替旋转配置能够产生更大的切向力。该方法无需额外的旋翼倾斜执行器或机构，即可实现空中与接触式两种运动模式。仿真结果展示了在自由空间中的悬停以及在地面上保持水平姿态的同时进行水平移动。

title: Continuous-Action World Models: Learning Cross-Embodiment Spatiotemporal Dynamics Priors
summary: We introduce Continuous-Action World Models (CoAWM), a framework for learning cross-embodiment spatiotemporal dynamics priors that support robot action generation across embodiments and execution frequencies. At its core is a shared latent function space that captures the spatial and temporal structure of robot actions. We learn this space through two stages. First, function pretraining brings trajectories from different embodiments and sampling frequencies into a common representation, learning shared dynamics priors through action reconstruction and consistency across temporal sampling views. By accommodating heterogeneous robot trajectories, this stage broadens the range of data sources available for pretraining and facilitates scaling to larger and more diverse datasets. Second, we connect the pretrained function space to a world-model backbone, enabling observations, language instructions, and the current robot state to condition the prediction of a latent action function. A single decoder takes any query time and returns the corresponding end-effector action. By separating shared dynamics priors from task-conditioned action selection and temporal sampling, our approach provides a unified foundation for transferring robot experience across embodiments and control frequencies.
tldr: CoAWM learns cross-embodiment spatiotemporal dynamics priors by pretraining a shared latent function space on heterogeneous robot trajectories, then connecting it to a world-model backbone for action generation at arbitrary query times.
tldr_zh: CoAWM 通过在异构机器人轨迹上预训练共享的潜在函数空间，并将其连接到世界模型主干，从而学习跨具身时空动态先验，以在任意查询时间生成动作。
summary_zh: 我们引入了连续动作世界模型（CoAWM），这是一个用于学习跨具身时空动力学先验的框架，支持跨具身和不同执行频率的机器人动作生成。其核心是一个共享的潜在函数空间，用于捕获机器人动作的时空结构。我们通过两个阶段来学习这个空间。首先，函数预训练将来自不同具身和采样频率的轨迹转换为共同表示，通过动作重建和跨时间采样视图的一致性来学习共享的动力学先验。通过适配异构的机器人轨迹，这一阶段拓宽了可用于预训练的数据源范围，并有助于扩展到更大、更多样化的数据集。其次，我们将预训练的函数空间与世界模型主干连接起来，使观测、语言指令和当前机器人状态能够条件化地预测潜在动作函数。单个解码器接受任意查询时间并返回相应的末端执行器动作。通过将共享动力学先验与任务条件化的动作选择及时间采样分离，我们的方法为跨具身和控制频率的机器人经验迁移提供了一个统一基础。

title: Learned Terminal Costs for Short-Horizon Model Predictive Control of Autonomous Trucks in Interactive Highway Traffic
summary: Autonomous highway driving for heavy-duty trucks is a challenging control problem. The greater mass, dimensions and intricate dynamics increase the requirements for cooperation from surrounding traffic in critical maneuvers, requiring a careful balance between safety constraints and efficient long-horizon decision making. Model Predictive Control (MPC) provides rigorous constraint satisfaction but relies on terminal cost which can limit its effectiveness at short, computationally affordable horizons. Reinforcement Learning (RL) captures long-term driving behavior but offers no constraint guarantees and tends toward overly conservative policies when trained under sparse collision penalties. In this paper, we propose a hybrid MPC and RL framework for highway driving in autonomous trucks, where a finite-horizon MPC, solved via dynamic programming, uses a pre-trained RL model for terminal cost estimation. We evaluate the framework in a simulation environment with reactive surrounding traffic and compare it against pure MPC with zero terminal cost, rollout with terminal cost estimation using a base policy, and pure RL. Results show that the hybrid approach achieves zero collisions with the lowest cost of any configuration.
tldr: This paper proposes a hybrid MPC-RL framework for autonomous truck highway driving, where a pre-trained RL policy provides terminal cost estimation for a short-horizon MPC, achieving zero collisions and the lowest cost in simulation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于自动驾驶卡车高速公路行驶的混合 MPC-RL 框架，其中预训练的 RL 策略为短时域 MPC 提供终端代价估计，在仿真中实现了零碰撞和最低代价。
summary_zh: 重型卡车在高速公路上的自动驾驶是一个具有挑战性的控制问题。其更大的质量、尺寸和复杂的动力学特性，在关键机动中对周围交通的配合提出了更高要求，需要在安全约束与高效的长时域决策之间仔细权衡。模型预测控制（MPC）能够严格满足约束，但依赖终端代价，这限制了其在短时域、计算可承受范围内的有效性。强化学习（RL）能够捕捉长期驾驶行为，但不提供约束保证，并且在稀疏碰撞惩罚下训练时倾向于过度保守的策略。本文提出了一种用于自动驾驶卡车高速公路行驶的MPC与RL混合框架，其中通过动态规划求解的有限时域MPC使用预训练的RL模型进行终端代价估计。我们在具有反应式周围交通的仿真环境中评估该框架，并将其与零终端代价的纯MPC、使用基础策略进行终端代价估计的rollout以及纯RL进行了比较。结果表明，该混合方法实现了零碰撞，并且在所有配置中代价最低。

title: RoboAtom: Large-scale Atomic-Action Supervision for Robot Learning
summary: Fine-grained action annotations can support skill reuse and compositional generalization in robot policies. However, robot datasets typically provide task-level instructions without subtask annotations. Although some include subtask labels, inconsistent formats and conventions hinder cross-source joint training. We propose RoboAtom-Data, which adds unified, time-aligned atomic-action annotations to existing data from multiple sources, covering 1.45 million trajectories, 6.88 million skill-labeled segments, and 16,882.1 hours. Our pipeline combines a unified protocol, large-scale manual annotation, propagation across repeated executions with the same ordered skill sequence, and multi-stage quality control. We evaluate the dataset through automatic atomic-action annotation and robot control. We construct RoboAtom-Bench to standardize evaluation of skill recognition and temporal boundary localization. Trained on the annotated data, RoboAtom-Anno achieves better automatic annotation performance than all evaluated open- and closed-source models on both RoboAtom-Bench and the external WGO-Bench. For robot control, atomic-action supervision paired with hierarchical execution improves task success over task-level baselines on LIBERO-Long, LIBERO-Plus, and RoboTwin. We will release the data, benchmark, model, and construction pipeline to support further research on skill-level robot learning.
tldr: RoboAtom introduces a large-scale atomic-action dataset with unified annotations, a benchmark for skill recognition, and an annotation model that improves robot control and compositional generalization.
tldr_zh: RoboAtom 提出了一个大规模原子动作数据集，包含统一标注、技能识别基准和标注模型，从而提升机器人控制和组合泛化能力。
summary_zh: 细粒度的动作标注能够支持机器人策略中的技能复用和组合泛化。然而，机器人数据集通常仅提供任务级指令，缺乏子任务标注。尽管部分数据集包含子任务标签，但格式和约定不一致，阻碍了跨来源数据的联合训练。我们提出RoboAtom-Data，为来自多个来源的现有数据添加统一、时间对齐的原子动作标注，覆盖145万条轨迹、688万个技能标注片段，总计16,882.1小时。我们的流程结合了统一协议、大规模人工标注、对具有相同有序技能序列的重复执行进行传播标注，以及多阶段质量控制。我们通过自动原子动作标注和机器人控制来评估该数据集。我们构建了RoboAtom-Bench，以标准化技能识别和时间边界定位的评估。在标注数据上训练的RoboAtom-Anno在RoboAtom-Bench和外部WGO-Bench上均取得了优于所有被评估的开源和闭源模型的自动标注性能。在机器人控制方面，原子动作监督结合分层执行在LIBERO-Long、LIBERO-Plus和RoboTwin上相比任务级基线提升了任务成功率。我们将发布数据、基准、模型及构建流程，以支持技能级机器人学习的进一步研究。

title: Don't Risk It!: Trajectory-Conditioned Distributional Risk for LiDAR-Only Crowd Navigation
summary: Efficient crowd navigation requires anticipating dynamic collision-free space without relying on fragile object tracking. We propose the Don't Risk It Planner (DRIP), an end-to-end LiDAR-only planning framework that couples occupancy forecasting with trajectory-conditioned clearance and uncertainty estimation. Operating directly on LiDAR-derived occupancy grid histories, DRIP predicts a distribution over minimum robot-obstacle clearance for candidate control sequences to evaluate collision risk. The model is trained using a risk cost that grounds predictive uncertainty directly in empirical collision outcomes rather than geometric regression alone. In closed-loop experiments with up to 45 pedestrians, DRIP achieves higher success rates with fewer collisions and reduced freezing behavior compared to state-of-the-art baselines.
tldr: DRIP is an end-to-end LiDAR-only crowd navigation planner that couples occupancy forecasting with trajectory-conditioned clearance and uncertainty estimation, training with a risk cost grounded in empirical collision outcomes. In closed-loop experiments with up to 45 pedestrians, it achieves higher success rates, fewer collisions, and reduced freezing compared to state-of-the-art baselines.
tldr_zh: DRIP 是一个端到端仅依赖 LiDAR 的人群导航规划器，将占据预测与轨迹条件下的间隙及不确定性估计相结合，并使用基于实际碰撞结果的风险代价进行训练。在多达 45 名行人的闭环实验中，相比最先进基线，它实现了更高的成功率、更少的碰撞和更少的冻结行为。
summary_zh: 高效的人群导航需要预测动态的无碰撞空间，而不能依赖脆弱的对象追踪。我们提出了“不冒险规划器”（DRIP），一种端到端的仅基于激光雷达的规划框架，将占用率预测与轨迹条件下的安全距离及不确定性估计相结合。DRIP直接基于激光雷达导出的占用栅格历史，预测候选控制序列对应的最小机器人-障碍物间距分布，以评估碰撞风险。该模型通过一种风险成本进行训练，该成本将预测不确定性直接与经验碰撞结果相联系，而非仅依赖于几何回归。在多达45名行人的闭环实验中，与最先进的基线方法相比，DRIP在减少碰撞和冻结行为的同时，实现了更高的成功率。

title: RoboSeed: Multidimensional Evaluation of Vision-Language-Action and World-Action Models: Capability, Resource Affordability, and Research Evidence
summary:
Choosing a robot action model requires evidence about task capability, adaptation cost, deployment requirements, and the reliability of reported conclusions. Success rates alone offer limited guidance to researchers with different computing budgets and goals. We propose RoboSeed, a multidimensional evaluation framework for vision-language-action (VLA) and world-action models (WAM), within a continuing program to train, evaluate, and openly release robot models with verifiable evidence for model selection.
  The framework defines five dimensions: capability, downstream training affordability, deployment affordability, locally verified research value, and reproduction evidence. It maps empirical measurements and audit criteria to 0-100 profiles using fixed normalization anchors, with balanced, training-constrained, and deployment-constrained preference settings. Interface and protocol checks establish when comparisons are appropriate. Missing measurements remain explicit, incomplete aggregate scores are withheld, and weighted input coverage identifies evidence gaps.
  We apply the framework to representative VLA and WAM models, drawing on local training, released-weight evaluation, task-level audits, and an evaluation-system study. The results reveal budget-dependent backbone choices, sensitivity to adaptation recipes, and differences between language and visual task interfaces. Reproducible scoring code and machine-readable evidence support extension to additional models. The study provides dimension-level assessments and priorities for further measurement, while incomplete serving traces and heterogeneous protocols preclude overall numerical rankings.
tldr: RoboSeed is a multidimensional evaluation framework for vision-language-action (VLA) and world-action models, assessing capability, affordability, and evidence quality to guide model selection under different computing budgets and research goals.
tldr_zh: RoboSeed 是一个针对视觉-语言-动作（VLA）和世界动作模型的多维评估框架，通过评估能力、资源可负担性和证据质量，为不同计算预算和研究目标下的模型选择提供指导。
summary_zh:
选择机器人动作模型需要关于任务能力、适配成本、部署要求以及所报告结论可靠性的证据。仅凭成功率难以为具有不同计算预算和目标的研究者提供充分指导。我们提出RoboSeed，一个面向视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型和世界-动作模型（WAM）的多维评估框架，属于一项持续进行的计划，旨在训练、评估并公开发布机器人模型，为模型选择提供可验证的证据。
  该框架定义了五个维度：能力、下游训练可负担性、部署可负担性、本地验证的研究价值以及复现证据。它通过固定归一化锚点将经验测量和审计标准映射为0-100的画像，并提供均衡型、训练受限型和部署受限型偏好设置。接口与协议检查确定何时进行比较是适当的。缺失测量结果保持明确标注，不完整的综合得分不予给出，加权输入覆盖率用于识别证据缺口。
  我们将该框架应用于代表性的VLA和WAM模型，依据本地训练、已发布权重评估、任务级审计以及一项评估系统研究。结果揭示了依赖预算的主干选择、对适配方案的敏感性，以及语言与视觉任务接口之间的差异。可复现的评分代码和机器可读证据支持扩展至更多模型。该研究提供了维度级评估和进一步测量的优先事项，而不完整的服务追踪和异构协议使得总体数值排名无法进行。

title: Gaze-Assisted Supervisory Control for Lunar Robotic Arm Teleoperation Under Concurrent Monitoring
summary: Rover-mounted robotic arms can extend human reach during lunar sample handling, but continuous joystick teleoperation requires repeated visual-motor alignment while operators may also need to monitor system states. This paper presents a gaze-assisted supervisory control framework in which gaze nominates a rock or placement target, explicit confirmation authorizes the action, and the robot performs bounded autonomous grasp-and-place execution. The framework was evaluated against manual joystick teleoperation in a mission-analog virtual reality study with 16 participants. The study used a 2 x 2 x 3 within-subject design varying control mode, placement difficulty, and concurrent monitoring load. Mean recorded task completion time decreased from 47.65 to 18.43 s per rock, with 72.5% of this difference arising during grasping. Under the tested auditory monitoring conditions, gaze-assisted supervisory control showed less average proportional slowing, with no detected control-mode difference in monitoring-response accuracy or speed. The rate of gaze shifts between core areas of interest decreased from 49.98 to 27.73 shifts/min, while the raw NASA Task Load Index score decreased from 32.54 to 18.26. However, the benefit was task dependent. In precision placement, manual control yielded lower mean placement error and a higher placement success rate. These findings support a mixed-initiative allocation in which gaze enables rapid task-level intention specification and autonomous execution, while precision-critical stages retain manual refinement.
tldr: This paper presents a gaze-assisted supervisory control framework for lunar robotic arm teleoperation, evaluated in a VR study with 16 participants, showing faster task completion and lower workload versus manual joystick control, but with reduced precision in high-accuracy placement.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种凝视辅助的月球机械臂遥操作监督控制框架，并在16名参与者的VR研究中与手动遥操作进行了对比，结果显示任务完成更快、负荷更低，但在高精度放置任务中精度有所下降。
summary_zh: 安装在漫游车上的机械臂可以扩展人类在月球样本处理过程中的操作范围，但连续的摇杆遥操作需要反复进行视觉-运动对齐，而操作者可能还需要同时监控系统状态。本文提出了一种 gaze-assisted supervisory control 框架，其中 gaze 用于指定岩石或放置目标，显式确认用于授权动作，机器人则执行有界自主的抓取与放置。该框架在一项任务模拟虚拟现实研究中与手动摇杆遥操作进行了对比评估，共有16名参与者。该研究采用了2 x 2 x 3的被试内设计，变化控制模式、放置难度和并发监控负载。记录的平均任务完成时间从每块岩石47.65秒降至18.43秒，其中72.5%的差异来自抓取阶段。在测试的听觉监控条件下，gaze-assisted supervisory control 显示出较小的平均比例减慢，并且在监控响应准确性或速度方面未检测到控制模式差异。核心兴趣区域之间的 gaze 转移频率从49.98次/分钟降至27.73次/分钟，而原始NASA任务负荷指数得分从32.54降至18.26。然而，这种收益具有任务依赖性。在精密放置中，手动控制产生了更低的平均放置误差和更高的放置成功率。这些发现支持一种混合主动分配，其中 gaze 能够实现快速的任务级意图指定和自主执行，而精度关键阶段则保留手动微调。

title: Compressed Orientation Reachability Maps for Sub-Second Robotic Needle Entry Point Planning
summary: In the context of multi-stage trajectory planning for robotic percutaneous liver interventions, identifying a kinematically feasible entry point remains a critical computational bottleneck. Existing methods rely on exhaustive inverse kinematics or randomized searches, incurring delays of 13 to 27 seconds per target and limiting real-time intraoperative adaptation. This paper introduces an Orientation-Based Reachability Map (ORM) that precomputes the kinematic feasibility of a 6 Degrees of Freedom (DoF) serial manipulator across 188,873 workspace positions and encodes orientation feasibility into a compact, indexed 83 MB map. A Just-In-Time (JIT) compiled runtime pipeline replaces live optimization with near-instantaneous array lookups. Experimental evaluation demonstrates a reduction in planning latency from 13.5-26.9 s to 0.289-0.349 s per target while maintaining high geometric fidelity, achieving a mean convex hull volume overlap ratio of 0.933 and a mean alpha-shape volume ratio of 0.976 relative to the baseline reachable point cloud. The proposed ORM framework enables sub-second entry point planning and provides an efficient computational framework for robotic needle insertion in percutaneous liver ablation.
tldr: This paper presents a precomputed Orientation-Based Reachability Map (ORM) that enables sub-second robotic needle entry point planning for percutaneous liver interventions, reducing latency from 13.5-26.9 s to 0.289-0.349 s per target while maintaining high geometric fidelity.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于预计算的方向可达性图（ORM），用于经皮肝脏介入手术中的机器人穿刺点规划，将每次目标的规划延迟从13.5-26.9秒降至0.289-0.349秒，同时保持较高的几何保真度。
summary_zh: 在机器人经皮肝脏介入治疗的多阶段轨迹规划中，识别运动学上可行的穿刺入口点仍是关键的计算瓶颈。现有方法依赖穷举逆运动学或随机搜索，每个目标点会产生13至27秒的延迟，限制了术中实时自适应能力。本文提出一种基于姿态的可达性地图（ORM），该方法预先计算六自由度（DoF）串联机械臂在188，873个工作空间位置上的运动学可行性，并将姿态可行性编码为紧凑的、带索引的83 MB地图。一种即时编译（JIT）的运行时流水线以近乎即时的数组查询替代实时优化。实验评估表明，规划延迟从每个目标点13.5至26.9秒降至0.289至0.349秒，同时保持较高的几何保真度，相对于基准可达点云，平均凸包体积重叠比为0.933，平均阿尔法形状体积比为0.976。所提出的ORM框架实现了亚秒级穿刺入口点规划，为经皮肝脏消融中的机器人穿刺针插入提供了高效的计算框架。

title: PASA-KV: Attacking Action-Facing Visual Routes in World Action Models
summary: World action models (WAMs) increasingly couple internal visual or world representations with action generation, making their world-to-action pathways a critical yet poorly understood source of robustness. We investigate when perturbations to these internal representations actually become behaviorally consequential, and uncover a pronounced mismatch between representation perturbability and closed-loop vulnerability: attack effectiveness varies sharply across visual K/V routes, while larger representation displacement does not reliably imply stronger control failure. Our analysis attributes this mismatch to the action-conditioned readout, where keys determine where action queries read and values determine what content they receive. This motivates an action-facing view of vulnerability, in which the effect of a perturbation depends on how it is routed into action generation rather than on representation-space magnitude alone. We instantiate this view with Tail-AV, a short-probe signal for identifying vulnerable routes, and operationalize it in PASA-KV, which selects action-facing K/V targets before training a fresh task-shared attack. Experiments across multiple WAM systems and a physical robot validate readout-informed target selection, demonstrate strong closed-loop attacks, and reveal substantial system-level differences in resistance.
tldr: This paper investigates robustness of world action models (WAMs) against perturbations to internal visual representations, proposing an action-facing vulnerability view and a method (PASA-KV) to select vulnerable K/V routes for effective closed-loop attacks, validated on WAM systems and a physical robot.
tldr_zh: 本文研究了世界动作模型（WAM）对内部视觉表示扰动的鲁棒性，提出了面向动作的脆弱性视角，并设计了PASA-KV方法选择脆弱的K/V路径进行有效闭环攻击，在多个WAM系统和实体机器人上得到验证。
summary_zh: 世界动作模型（WAMs）越来越多地将内部视觉或世界表示与动作生成相结合，使得其从世界到动作的通路成为鲁棒性的关键来源，但这一通路目前尚缺乏充分理解。我们研究了这些内部表示的扰动在何时会真正产生行为后果，并发现了表示可扰动性与闭环脆弱性之间的显著错配：攻击效果在不同视觉K/V路径上差异显著，而更大的表示位移并不必然意味着更严重的控制失效。我们的分析将该错配归因于动作条件化的读取机制，其中键（keys）决定动作查询在何处读取，值（values）决定它们接收到的内容。这促使我们提出一种面向动作的脆弱性视角，即扰动的影响取决于其如何被路由到动作生成过程，而不仅仅取决于表示空间中的幅度大小。我们将这一视角具体化为Tail-AV，一种用于识别脆弱路径的短探针信号，并在PASA-KV中加以实现，该方法在训练全新任务共享攻击之前选择面向动作的K/V目标。在多个WAM系统及一台实体机器人上的实验结果验证了基于读取机制的目标选择的有效性，展示了强闭环攻击能力，并揭示了系统级别在抗攻击能力上的显著差异。

title: Decoding Geometry, Not Tokens: Efficient VLMs for Robot Affordance and Trajectory Prediction
summary: Predicting where to grasp and how to move is fundamentally a geometry problem. Vision-language models treat it as language generation instead. They tokenize spatial coordinates into text and decode them autoregressively. This mechanism ignores spatial structure and truncates continuous precision. Errors compound across coordinate tokens during decoding. In this paper, we show that compact off-the-shelf VLMs with 0.5-2B parameters already encode rich spatial information in their intermediate hidden states. Autoregressive decoding is the dominant bottleneck for trajectory prediction, while affordance prediction depends additionally on feature depth and decoder architecture. We expose the latent spatial information with a lightweight, geometry-compatible prediction head that attaches to a frozen backbone. It reads features from an intermediate hidden layer, conditions a learned query on the task instruction and refines it via cross-attention over the visual tokens to regress affordance boxes and trajectory waypoints directly as continuous values, without modifying the backbone. We evaluate on ShareRobot-Bench and AGD20K. Our 2B variant reduces trajectory error by over 60% and improves ShareRobot-Bench affordance mAP by 85% relative to the autoregressive baseline. It approaches RoboBrain on trajectory prediction (0.251 vs 0.191 DFD) at 3.8x higher throughput. These results demonstrate a favorable accuracy-efficiency trade-off for instruction-conditioned 2D geometric prediction.
tldr: This paper shows that compact frozen VLMs (0.5-2B) already encode rich spatial information in hidden states, and a lightweight geometry head regressing affordance boxes and trajectories directly outperforms autoregressive coordinate decoding with large accuracy gains and 3.8x throughput.
tldr_zh: 本文表明，0.5-2B的紧凑型冻结VLM其隐藏状态已包含丰富空间信息；通过一个轻量几何预测头直接回归可操作区域与轨迹，相比自回归解码大幅提升精度，并实现3.8倍吞吐量。
summary_zh: 预测抓取位置和运动方式本质上是一个几何问题。然而，视觉语言模型将其视为语言生成任务。它们将空间坐标标记化为文本，并以自回归方式解码。这种机制忽略了空间结构，并截断了连续精度。解码过程中，误差在坐标标记之间逐步累积。在本文中，我们表明，参数量仅为0.5-2B的紧凑型现成VLM其中间隐藏状态已经编码了丰富的空间信息。自回归解码是轨迹预测的主要瓶颈，而可供性预测还额外依赖于特征深度和解码器架构。我们通过一个轻量级、几何兼容的预测头来暴露潜在空间信息，该预测头附加在冻结骨干网络上。它从中间隐藏层读取特征，将学习到的查询以任务指令为条件，并通过视觉标记上的交叉注意力进行精炼，从而直接以连续值回归可供性框和轨迹路点，而无需修改骨干网络。我们在ShareRobot-Bench和AGD20K上进行评估。相较于自回归基线，我们的2B变体将轨迹误差降低了60%以上，并将ShareRobot-Bench可供性mAP提升了85%。它在轨迹预测上接近RoboBrain（0.251 vs 0.191 DFD），同时吞吐量提高了3.8倍。这些结果表明，对于指令条件下的2D几何预测，该方法实现了有利的精度-效率权衡。

title: Information-Driven Collaborative Autonomy for Heterogeneous UAV/UGV Teams
summary: This paper considers coordinating a heterogeneous team of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) and unmanned ground vehicles (UGVs) traversing a domain containing an unknown number of potentially hazardous targets. The UAVs provide aerial sensing using onboard optical cameras, adapting their trajectories to ground routes and target information. We formulate the aerial search problem using ergodic control, which distributes sensing effort according to a spatial information density to balance exploration and target localization. The formulation incorporates dynamic camera field-of-view footprints and pose-dependent probabilistic detection models. Angles-only measurements are processed through Bayesian inference and marginalization over data-association hypotheses to obtain a Poisson multi-Bernoulli (PMB) approximation of the target posterior, representing both detected and undetected targets. This belief directs aerial sensing toward unexplored regions along the ground routes and viewpoints that improve target localization. Ground planning combines chance-constrained target avoidance, enforced through confidence sets, with a void-probability objective that favors routes unlikely to contain threats. We solve each team's optimization problem in a fully decentralized manner using a nested SCvx*--C-ADMM scheme, with outer sequential convex programming iterations and inner distributed consensus optimization, accounting for nonlinearities, nonseparable objectives, and continuous-time inter-agent separation constraints. A closed-loop scheme updates both fleets' trajectories as information becomes available and permits ground motion when the remaining route risk falls below a prescribed threshold. Numerical case studies examine sensing geometry and target uncertainty, compare decentralized and centralized solvers, and demonstrate full closed-loop collaboration between multiple UAVs and UGVs.
tldr: This paper proposes a decentralized, information-driven framework for coordinating heterogeneous UAV/UGV teams to search for hazardous targets, combining ergodic control for aerial sensing, PMB Bayesian inference for target belief, and chance-constrained ground planning with an SCvx*-C-ADMM optimization scheme.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种去中心化、信息驱动的异构无人机/地面车辆团队协调框架，用于搜索危险目标，结合遍历控制进行空中感知、PMB贝叶斯推断进行目标置信度估计，以及带有SCvx*-C-ADMM优化方案的几率约束地面规划。
summary_zh: 本文研究了一组由无人机（UAV）和无人地面车辆（UGV）组成的异构团队的协同问题，该团队需要穿越一个包含未知数量潜在危险目标的区域。无人机利用机载光学相机提供空中感知，并根据地面路线和目标信息调整其轨迹。我们采用遍历控制（ergodic control）来构建空中搜索问题，该方法根据空间信息密度分配感知努力，以平衡探索与目标定位。该公式化方法纳入了动态相机视场覆盖范围以及依赖于姿态的概率检测模型。仅角度测量通过贝叶斯推断和关于数据关联假设的边缘化进行处理，以获得目标后验的泊松多伯努利（PMB）近似，该近似同时表示已检测和未检测的目标。这一信念引导空中感知朝向地面路线沿线未探索的区域以及能够改善目标定位的视角。地面规划将机会约束目标规避（通过置信集实现）与利于不太可能包含威胁的路径的空隙概率目标相结合。我们采用嵌套SCvx*--C-ADMM方案以完全去中心化的方式求解每个团队的优化问题，外层为序列凸规划迭代，内层为分布式共识优化，同时考虑非线性、不可分离目标以及连续时间智能体间分离约束。闭环方案随着信息的获取更新两个车队的轨迹，并在剩余路线风险降至规定阈值以下时允许地面运动。数值案例研究考察了感知几何与目标不确定性，比较了去中心化与集中式求解器，并展示了多架无人机与无人地面车辆之间的完整闭环协作。

title: ProLoop: Progress-Aware Closed-Loop Framework via Structured State Relations for Long-Horizon Robotic Task Planning
summary: Long-horizon robotic tasks are commonly decomposed into semantic subgoals to simplify planning. However, subgoal progress in LLM-based planning is typically inferred implicitly from interaction histories. Inaccurate estimates can misguide execution and allow local errors to propagate. To address this, we propose ProLoop, a Progress-Aware Closed-Loop framework that derives explicit subgoal progress from structured relations between desired and execution states. A learned State-Relation Monitor assesses these relations, which are then aggregated into subgoal progress as ongoing, deviated, or completed. The resulting progress guides execution adaptation, enabling reliable progress-aware control throughout execution. Experiments on AgentBoard ALFWorld and a real-world robotic platform show that ProLoop improves success rate by 12.94% overall and by 15.46% on Hard tasks, while reducing environment interactions by 32.3%.
tldr: ProLoop introduces a progress-aware closed-loop framework that derives explicit subgoal progress from structured relations between desired and execution states, improving long-horizon robotic task planning success rates and reducing environment interactions.
tldr_zh: ProLoop 提出了一种进度感知的闭环框架，通过期望状态与执行状态之间的结构化关系推导显式子目标进度，提高了长时程机器人任务规划的成功率并减少了环境交互。
summary_zh: 长时程机器人任务通常被分解为语义性子目标以简化规划过程。然而，在基于大语言模型的规划中，子目标的进展通常是从交互历史中隐式推断得出的。不准确的估计可能会误导执行过程，并使局部错误得以传播。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了ProLoop，一个进展感知的闭环框架，通过期望状态与执行状态之间的结构化关系来推导显式的子目标进展。一个经学习的状态-关系监测器评估这些关系，并将其汇总为子目标进展状态，包括进行中、偏离或已完成。由此产生的进展信息指导执行过程的适应性调整，从而在整个执行过程中实现可靠的进展感知控制。在AgentBoard ALFWorld以及真实机器人平台上的实验表明，ProLoop在总体任务上的成功率提升了12.94%，在困难任务上提升了15.46%，同时将环境交互次数减少了32.3%。

title: Language-Grounded Force/Torque Pretraining for Extrinsic Contact Perception
summary: Fine manipulation requires robots to recognize when a grasped object makes or changes contact with its environment, yet such extrinsic contact is not always directly observable from vision or local contact geometry. Force and torque signals carry this information, but also vary with object weight, grasp configuration, and robot motion, leaving it unclear whether they can provide a reusable representation of physical state. Here we show that bilateral six-axis force/torque histories can be pretrained as a semantically structured physical representation by aligning them with a frozen language space using supervision generated from simulated pick-and-place interactions. On unseen objects in simulation, the learned representation supports text-prototype readout of robot action, object weight, and grasp interaction. In real-world placement, unlabeled calibration enables contact and support-state recognition without updating the encoder, outperforming a vertical-force sign-reversal rule baseline. For connector insertion, an event absent from pretraining, low-rank adaptation improves data-efficient learning over training from scratch. These results show that force/torque histories can support both direct readout of known physical states and efficient adaptation to new extrinsic-contact events.
tldr: This paper proposes a method to pretrain force/torque histories as a semantically structured physical representation by aligning them with a frozen language space, enabling direct readout of physical states and efficient adaptation to new extrinsic-contact events in manipulation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种通过将力/力矩历史与冻结的语言空间对齐来预训练语义化物理表征的方法，使得能够直接读取物理状态并高效适应新的外部接触事件。
summary_zh: 精细操作要求机器人能够识别被抓取物体何时与环境发生接触或接触状态发生变化，然而这种外部接触往往无法通过视觉或局部接触几何直接观测到。力与力矩信号携带了此类信息，但同时也会随物体重量、抓取构型和机器人运动而变化，因此尚不明确这些信号能否提供一种可复用的物理状态表征。本文证明，通过对模拟拾放交互生成的有监督信号进行对齐，双侧六轴力/力矩历史序列可以预训练为一种语义结构化的物理表征，并与冻结的语言空间相对齐。在仿真环境中对未见过物体，所学表征支持基于文本原型对机器人动作、物体重量和抓取交互进行读取。在真实场景的放置任务中，无标注的校准使得无需更新编码器即可实现接触与支撑状态识别，其性能优于基于垂直力符号翻转规则的基线方法。对于预训练中未出现的事件——连接器插入任务，低秩自适应相比从头训练显著提升了数据效率。上述结果表明，力/力矩历史序列既能支持对已知物理状态的直接读取，也能高效适应新的外部接触事件。

title: WorldFlow: Joint Video and 3D Motion Prediction via Large-Scale Pretraining
summary: Predicting future physical states stands as a central challenge in embodied intelligence. Existing video world models leave 3D dynamics implicit, action-based formulations remain tied to specific robot configurations, and 3D motion prediction models use flow-only supervision, providing a limited learning signal for physical dynamics. To circumvent these limitations, we introduce \method{}, a generative world model that jointly predicts future video and query-based 3D trajectories. By parameterizing 3D motion as continuous displacement tokens aligned with the video grid, a unified Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) backbone jointly denoises both modalities under a rectified-flow objective. This formulation couples explicit geometric dynamics with visual evolution, effectively unlocking the physical commonsense embedded within pretrained video models. To empirically scale and validate this unified architecture, we train \method{} on a heterogeneous mixture of 1.44 million object-level samples spanning simulated and real-world domains. We further introduce WorldFlowBench, comprising 1,678 evaluation samples from 11 data sources across simulated and real-world interactions, including spatial reasoning tasks. Across all three evaluation sets, WorldFlow achieves the lowest average displacement error (ADE) and final displacement error (FDE) among the evaluated learning-based methods. Notably, on the challenging SpatialCog set, WorldFlow achieves an ADE of 0.060 m, a 54.2\% reduction compared with the strongest external baseline. It also reduces ADE and FDE by 55.9\% and 68.5\%, respectively, compared with its flow-only variant. Project page: https://worldflow-rbs.github.io/.
tldr: WorldFlow is a generative world model that jointly predicts future video and query-based 3D trajectories using a unified Mixture-of-Transformers backbone, pretrained on 1.44M object-level samples and validated on the new WorldFlowBench, achieving state-of-the-art accuracy on 3D motion prediction and spatial reasoning tasks.
tldr_zh: WorldFlow 是一个生成式世界模型，通过统一的混合变换器骨干网络联合预测未来视频和基于查询的3D轨迹，在144万物体级样本上预训练，并在新的WorldFlowBench基准上验证，在3D运动预测和空间推理任务上达到最先进水平。
summary_zh: 预测未来物理状态是具身智能中的核心挑战。现有视频世界模型将三维动力学保持为隐式表达，基于动作的公式化方法仍受限于特定机器人构型，而三维运动预测模型仅使用光流监督，为物理动力学提供的学习信号十分有限。为克服上述局限，我们提出\method{}，一种联合预测未来视频与基于查询的三维轨迹的生成式世界模型。通过将三维运动参数化为与视频网格对齐的连续位移令牌，一个统一的混合变换器（Mixture-of-Transformers, MoT）主干在修正流目标下联合去噪两种模态。该公式将显式几何动力学与视觉演化相耦合，有效释放了预训练视频模型中所蕴含的物理常识。为在经验上扩展并验证这一统一架构，我们在涵盖仿真域与真实世界域的异构混合数据集上训练\method{}，共包含144万个对象级样本。我们进一步引入WorldFlowBench，包含来自11个数据源的1,678个评估样本，覆盖仿真与真实世界交互，其中包含空间推理任务。在所有三组评估集上，WorldFlow在所评估的基于学习方法中取得了最低的平均位移误差（ADE）与最终位移误差（FDE）。值得注意的是，在具有挑战性的SpatialCog数据集上，WorldFlow取得了0.060米的ADE，较最强外部基线降低了54.2%。与其仅使用光流监督的变体相比，WorldFlow的ADE和FDE分别降低了55.9%和68.5%。项目主页：https://worldflow-rbs.github.io/。

title: RAIBO-Wagon: Real-Time Navigation System for a Legged Robot Towing a Wagon
summary: Legged robots have demonstrated advanced capabilities across a wide range of real-world tasks, yet much of this progress concerns the robot controlling only itself. Once the robot is coupled to an external object -- particularly an underactuated one -- the dynamics of the combined assembly become more complex. Towing a wagon is a common practical scenario, where coupled dynamics make reliable navigation challenging. This difficulty is amplified in confined spaces, where collision-free navigation requires finding a narrow set of feasible paths under strict real-time constraints. To address this, we propose a navigation framework that combines Conditional Flow Matching (CFM) with Model Predictive Path Integral (MPPI) control over a learned Forward Dynamics Model (FDM). The CFM model mitigates the initialization problem of MPPI and accelerates its convergence, while MPPI with the FDM recovers feasible solutions beyond the CFM model's training distribution by iterative refinement. We integrate the framework into a full-stack navigation system for RAIBO-Wagon, a quadruped towing a custom wagon, and validate it in real-world outdoor experiments on 15 m-long courses through confined spaces, with all sensing and computation performed fully onboard. The system achieves an 85% success rate across 40 trials, towing a total load of up to 40 kg -- nearly 100% of RAIBO's body weight.
tldr: This paper presents a real-time navigation framework for a quadruped robot towing a wagon, combining Conditional Flow Matching with MPPI control over a learned forward dynamics model, and validates it in real-world outdoor experiments with an 85% success rate.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于四足机器人拖拽四轮车的实时导航框架，结合条件流匹配与基于学习前向动力学模型的MPPI控制，并在真实户外实验中实现了85%的成功率。
summary_zh: 腿式机器人在广泛的实际任务中展现出先进的能力，然而这些进展大多集中于机器人仅控制自身的情况。一旦机器人耦连到外部物体——尤其是欠驱动物体——组合系统的动力学特性将变得更加复杂。牵引拖车是一种常见的实际场景，耦合动力学使得可靠导航充满挑战。这一困难在狭小空间中更为突出，因为无碰撞导航需要在严格的实时约束下找到一组狭窄的可行路径。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一种导航框架，该框架将条件流匹配（CFM）与基于学习的前向动力学模型（FDM）的模型预测路径积分（MPPI）控制相结合。CFM模型缓解了MPPI的初始化问题并加速其收敛，而结合FDM的MPPI通过迭代细化，能够恢复超出CFM模型训练分布范围的可行解。我们将该框架集成到RAIBO-Wagon（一条四足机器人牵引定制拖车）的全栈导航系统中，并在15米长的狭小空间户外实地实验中进行了验证，所有感知和计算均在机载设备上完全完成。该系统在40次试验中实现了85%的成功率，总牵引负载高达40公斤——接近RAIBO自身体重的100%。

title: CAPTURER: A Dexterous Aerial Manipulator for Dynamic and Precise Grasping across Diverse Environments
summary: As a representative form of embodied robotic interaction, aerial grasping requires close coordination between the aerial platform and manipulator. Most existing systems perform aerial grasping with static or slowly moving targets under fixed scenarios. Dynamic and precise grasping across different conditions introduces additional challenges, including target motion, localization drift, dynamic coupling, and external disturbances. In this work, we present CAPTURER, a dexterous aerial manipulator for centimeter-level grasping across diverse environments. To achieve the challenging goal, we first develop an onboard perception system for state estimation and target detection. Drift correction and global pose transformation are introduced to improve target localization during flight. A cooperative motion planner is proposed to coordinate the mobility of the aerial platform with the dexterity of the manipulator according to the relative target state. To maintain grasping accuracy under disturbances, we design a disturbance-rejection controller to compensate for dynamic coupling, model uncertainty, and external disturbances. The capability of CAPTURER is validated through indoor and outdoor experiments with both static and moving targets. The results demonstrate that CAPTURER achieves centimeter-level grasping accuracy for a marker pen measuring only 1.5 cm in diameter at flight speeds exceeding 1.5 m/s.
tldr: CAPTURER is a dexterous aerial manipulator that achieves centimeter-level dynamic grasping across diverse environments via onboard perception with drift correction, cooperative motion planning, and disturbance-rejection control.
tldr_zh: CAPTURER是一种灵巧的空中机械臂，通过机载感知、漂移校正、协同运动规划和扰动抑制控制，在多样环境中实现厘米级动态抓取。
summary_zh: 作为具身机器人交互的一种代表性形式，空中抓取需要空中平台与机械臂之间的紧密协调。现有大多数系统在固定场景下对静态或缓慢移动的目标执行空中抓取。跨不同条件的动态精确抓取带来了额外挑战，包括目标运动、定位漂移、动态耦合和外部扰动。在本工作中，我们提出了CAPTURER，一种用于跨多样环境实现厘米级抓取的灵巧空中机械臂。为实现这一具有挑战性的目标，我们首先开发了一套用于状态估计和目标检测的机载感知系统。引入了漂移校正和全局位姿变换，以在飞行过程中提高目标定位精度。提出了一种协同运动规划器，根据相对目标状态协调空中平台的机动性与机械臂的灵巧性。为了在扰动下保持抓取精度，我们设计了一种扰动抑制控制器，以补偿动态耦合、模型不确定性和外部扰动。CAPTURER的能力通过室内和室外实验进行了验证，涵盖静态和移动目标。结果表明，CAPTURER在飞行速度超过1.5 m/s时，对直径仅为1.5 cm的记号笔实现了厘米级抓取精度。

title: Controlling Continuum Robot Shape in Enclosed Space with Embedded Sensing using IMU and Actuator Feedback
summary: Controlling continuum robots' shape to operate in confined, enclosed environments is challenging, since it cannot rely on external observation. Existing embedded shape sensing methods, although they can provide shape reconstruction, are insufficient to enable real-time shape control due to limitations in reconstruction accuracy, computational speed, and compatibility with shape-state representation. In this work, we present an embedded shape-sensing framework that uses readily available IMU and actuator feedback to reconstruct the continuum-robot shape with a neural network, providing accurate shape feedback at $400~\mathrm{Hz}$ for physical closed-loop control. We systematically investigate four key reconstruction design choices: shape-state representation, network architecture, training objective, and sensing inputs, through more than $5{,}000$ trained models on one- and three-segment continuum robots. The selected framework achieves global shape errors of $0.9\%L$ and $1.7\%L$ (of the robot length) for the one- and three-segment systems, respectively. In closed-loop control, one-segment tip tracking achieves a $6.1\%L$ error and three-segment shape control achieves a $2.3\%L$ global shape error, whereas IMU--PCC reconstruction using the same uncompensated measurements fails. Enclosed-space experiments further demonstrate operation without external observation. These results provide a practical framework for translating readily available embedded sensing into high-rate feedback for continuum robot closed-loop control.
tldr: This paper presents an embedded shape-sensing and closed-loop control framework for continuum robots in enclosed spaces, using IMU and actuator feedback with a neural network to achieve high-rate (400 Hz) shape reconstruction and control, validated in physical experiments.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于封闭空间连续体机器人的嵌入式形状感知与闭环控制框架，利用IMU和执行器反馈及神经网络实现高速（400 Hz）形状重建与控制，并在物理实验中验证。
summary_zh: 控制连续体机器人在狭窄封闭环境中的形状以进行操作具有挑战性，因为它无法依赖外部观测。现有的嵌入式形状传感方法虽然能够提供形状重建，但由于在重建精度、计算速度以及与形状状态表示的兼容性方面存在局限，不足以实现实时形状控制。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种嵌入式形状传感框架，利用现成的IMU和执行器反馈，通过神经网络重建连续体机器人的形状，以$400~\mathrm{Hz}$的频率提供精确的形状反馈，用于物理闭环控制。我们通过在单段和三段连续体机器人上训练超过$5{,}000$个模型，系统地研究了四个关键的重建设计选择：形状状态表示、网络架构、训练目标和传感输入。所选框架在单段和三段系统上分别实现了$0.9\%L$和$1.7\%L$（相对于机器人长度）的全局形状误差。在闭环控制中，单段末端跟踪实现了$6.1\%L$的误差，三段形状控制实现了$2.3\%L$的全局形状误差，而使用相同未补偿测量的IMU--PCC重建则失败。封闭空间实验进一步证明了无需外部观测的操作。这些结果为将现成的嵌入式传感转化为连续体机器人闭环控制所需的高速率反馈提供了一个实用框架。

title: Robotic Data Inoculation
summary: Modern robot learning systems feed on high-quality demonstration data, and their performance hinges on coverage. Without good coverage, small errors compound and the policy can quickly go into out-of-distribution states from which it cannot recover. Yet there is no principled way of collecting high-coverage data, and data collection often relies on heuristic instructions to human operators. Purely online reinforcement learning (RL) explores at the cost of safety and sample efficiency, while DAgger-style interventions require the policy to fail by chance before a human can correct it. In this paper, we ask instead whether we can modify how the robot behaves during data collection to collect more useful data. We propose Data Inoculation (DI), a shared-control framework in which a human provide closed-loop teleoperation commands while a residual policy perturbs these commands. The residual policy is trained online, on the growing dataset, with the same reward-maximizing objective later used for policy extraction, so its perturbations steer data collection toward the deviations a policy trained on the data would make. These perturbations expose the robot to a wider range of states, while the human's continuous corrections provide recovery demonstrations, "inoculating" the dataset against the learner's future mistakes while the human remains in control. On three challenging real-world robotic tasks, DI consistently improves or matches the success rate of policies trained with both behavioral cloning and offline RL, showing DI as an effective data collection strategy for improving downstream policy performance.
tldr: Data Inoculation is a shared-control data collection framework where a human teleoperates while an online-trained residual policy perturbs commands, exposing the robot to diverse states and generating recovery demonstrations that improve downstream policy performance.
tldr_zh: Data Inoculation 是一种共享控制数据采集框架：人类进行遥操作，同时在线训练的残差策略扰动指令，使机器人暴露于更多状态并产生恢复演示，从而提升下游策略性能。
summary_zh:
摘要：
现代机器人学习系统依赖于高质量的示范数据，其性能在很大程度上取决于数据覆盖面。若覆盖面不足，微小误差会不断累积，策略可能迅速进入分布外状态，从而无法恢复。然而，目前尚无系统化的方法用于收集高覆盖率数据，数据采集往往依赖于向人类操作员提供的启发式指令。纯在线强化学习（RL）以牺牲安全性和样本效率为代价进行探索，而DAgger式干预则要求策略在人类能够纠正之前偶然失败。本文转而探讨是否可以通过修改机器人在数据采集过程中的行为方式来收集更有价值的数据。为此，我们提出“数据接种”（Data Inoculation, DI），一种共享控制框架，在该框架中，人类提供闭环遥操作指令，同时一个残差策略对这些指令进行扰动。该残差策略基于不断增长的数据集进行在线训练，并采用与后续策略提取阶段相同的奖励最大化目标，因此其扰动能够将数据采集引导至基于当前数据训练的策略可能产生的偏差方向。这些扰动使机器人暴露于更广泛的状状空间，而人类的持续纠正则提供了恢复示范，从而在人类保持控制的同时，对未来学习者的错误进行“接种”式防御。在三个具有挑战性的真实机器人任务中，DI持续提升或匹配基于行为克隆和离线RL训练策略的成功率，表明DI是一种有效的数据采集策略，可提升下游策略性能。

title: Self-Supervised Doppler-Guided RF Odometry
summary: Radio-frequency (RF) sensing enables robot ego-motion estimation in darkness, smoke, and fog, yet RF odometry remains challenging because multipath and moving reflectors make cross-frame matching highly ambiguous. Existing methods often rely on auxiliary inertial sensors or ground-truth pose supervision. We present RFWalk, a self-supervised, RF-only odometry framework that models dense correspondences across range-azimuth frames as random walks on a space-time graph and learns them from unlabeled sequences through temporal cycle consistency. To rule out correspondences that are cycle-consistent but physically implausible, we introduce a Doppler consistency loss that constrains correspondence-induced motion using radial velocity measured by the RF sensor itself. Ego-motion is then recovered through robust $\mathrm{SE}(2)$ registration that suppresses uncertain correspondences and those arising from independently moving objects. Without pose labels or auxiliary sensors, RFWalk remains competitive with supervised baselines in static scenes and reduces absolute trajectory error by 58% in dynamic scenes with moving pedestrians.
tldr: RFWalk is a self-supervised RF-only odometry framework that learns dense correspondences via cycle consistency and a Doppler consistency loss, then recovers robot ego-motion through robust SE(2) registration, achieving competitive accuracy without pose labels or auxiliary sensors.
tldr_zh: RFWalk是一个自监督的纯射频里程计框架，通过循环一致性和多普勒一致性损失学习稠密对应关系，并利用鲁棒的SE(2)配准恢复机器人自运动，在无位姿标签和辅助传感器的情况下达到有竞争力的精度。
summary_zh: 射频（RF）感知能够在黑暗、烟雾和雾霾环境中实现机器人自运动估计，然而由于多径效应和移动反射体导致跨帧匹配高度模糊，射频里程计仍面临挑战。现有方法通常依赖辅助惯性传感器或真实位姿监督。我们提出RFWalk，一种自监督的纯射频里程计框架，该框架将距离-方位帧之间的密集对应关系建模为时空图上的随机游走，并通过时间循环一致性从无标签序列中学习这些对应关系。为了排除那些满足循环一致性但在物理上不可信的对应关系，我们引入了一种多普勒一致性损失，利用射频传感器自身测量的径向速度来约束由对应关系诱导的运动。随后通过鲁棒的$\mathrm{SE}(2)$配准恢复自运动，该配准能够抑制不确定的对应关系以及由独立运动物体产生的对应关系。在没有位姿标签或辅助传感器的情况下，RFWalk在静态场景中与有监督基线方法保持竞争力，并在存在行人运动的动态场景中将绝对轨迹误差降低了58%。

title: Open-World Object Motion Anticipation via Meta-Learned Semantic Adaptation
summary: Anticipating the motion of nearby objects is critical for safe and efficient robot navigation. Without a proper understanding of what may move, a robot may plan overly conservative, inefficient trajectories to guarantee safety, or it may be overly risky, resulting in unacceptable collisions. While tracking and predicting the motion of known objects has seen significant progress, little research addresses how a robot should adapt online to novel objects, including anticipating how one object may move another (e.g., a person operating a forklift to move a pallet). To enable this capability, we propose a meta-learned graph neural network that leverages a semantic, geometric, and relational history of objects to accurately predict, from a few online observations, when objects will begin to move in new environments. We demonstrate that our method, which is trained only in simulation, accurately anticipates the motion of objects unseen at training time, transfers to hardware without any fine-tuning, and outperforms a vision-language model and a class-frequency baseline in both simulation and hardware experiments. Our method's accurate prediction enables collision-free traversals in a closed-loop navigation simulation, while remaining within four seconds of the fastest, collision-prone planner.
tldr: This paper proposes a meta-learned graph neural network that predicts the motion of novel objects in open-world robot navigation by leveraging semantic, geometric, and relational histories, and demonstrates superior performance over a VLM and baseline in simulation and on hardware.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种元学习图神经网络，通过利用语义、几何和关系历史来预测开放世界机器人导航中新物体的运动，并在仿真和硬件上展示了优于VLM和基线的性能。
summary_zh: 预测附近物体的运动对于安全高效的机器人导航至关重要。如果机器人不能正确理解哪些物体可能移动，它可能会规划过于保守、低效的轨迹以确保安全，或者可能过于冒险，导致不可接受的碰撞。尽管在跟踪和预测已知物体的运动方面已取得显著进展，但很少有研究关注机器人应如何在线适应新物体，包括预测一个物体可能如何移动另一个物体（例如，人操作叉车来移动托盘）。为了实现这一能力，我们提出了一种元学习图神经网络，利用物体的语义、几何和关系历史，从少量在线观测中准确预测物体在新环境中何时开始移动。我们证明，我们的方法仅在仿真中训练，却能准确预测训练时未见过的物体的运动，无需任何微调即可迁移到硬件，并在仿真和硬件实验中均优于视觉语言模型和类别频率基线。我们的方法通过准确预测，在闭环导航仿真中实现了无碰撞通行，同时与最快的、易发生碰撞的规划器相比，时间差距保持在四秒以内。

title: Learning Event-based Obstacle Avoidance via Differentiable Simulation
summary: Reliable obstacle avoidance is essential for safe quadrotor flight in unknown environments, yet conventional frame-based cameras remain challenged by motion blur, limited dynamic range, and latency under fast motion. Event cameras, with sub-millisecond latency, high dynamic range, and negligible motion blur, offer a promising alternative, but leveraging them for closed-loop control remains difficult. Existing approaches either adopt cascaded architectures that first estimate depth and then map it to control commands, introducing error propagation, or achieve end-to-end control through costly offline pretraining before online fine-tuning can even begin. We address these challenges with a CUDA-based event simulator that exploits GPU parallelism to render events efficiently within the training loop, integrated into a differentiable simulation pipeline that enables direct gradient backpropagation through the differentiable physics model, improving sample efficiency. This allows us to train an end-to-end policy that maps event frames directly to control commands, without intermediate depth estimation. We validate our approach through zero-shot real-world deployment on a quadrotor, achieving robust obstacle avoidance in both odometry-assisted and odometry-free settings, including under low-light conditions where conventional cameras typically fail.
tldr: This paper introduces a CUDA-based event simulator integrated into a differentiable simulation pipeline to train an end-to-end quadrotor obstacle avoidance policy mapping event frames directly to control commands, validated with zero-shot real-world deployment.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于CUDA的事件模拟器，集成到可微分仿真流程中，训练将事件帧直接映射到控制命令的四旋翼避障端到端策略，并通过零样本真实世界部署验证。
summary_zh: 可靠的避障能力是四旋翼飞行器在未知环境中安全飞行的关键，然而传统基于帧的相机在快速运动下仍然受制于运动模糊、动态范围有限和延迟等问题。事件相机具有亚毫秒级延迟、高动态范围和可忽略的运动模糊等优势，提供了一种有前景的替代方案，但将其用于闭环控制仍然困难。现有方法要么采用级联架构，先估计深度再将其映射为控制指令，从而引入误差传播；要么通过昂贵的离线预训练实现端到端控制，之后才能开始在线微调。我们通过一种基于CUDA的事件模拟器来应对这些挑战，该模拟器利用GPU并行性在训练循环内高效渲染事件，并集成到可微分仿真流水线中，使梯度能够通过可微分物理模型直接反向传播，从而提升样本效率。这使我们能够训练一个端到端策略，将事件帧直接映射为控制指令，无需中间深度估计。我们通过在四旋翼上进行零样本真实世界部署验证了所提方法，在带里程计和无里程计设置下均实现了鲁棒的避障，包括在传统相机通常会失效的低光照条件下。

title: Value Function-Guided MPPI for Hierarchical Planning and Control in Off-Road Autonomous Navigation
summary: Autonomous navigation in off-road terrain is commonly achieved using hierarchical control and planning architectures that rely on explicit cost maps and one-way information flow from a high-level planner to a low-level controller, decoupling planning from the true execution cost experienced during control. We propose a hierarchical planning and control framework in which information flows bidirectionally, allowing the low-level controller to guide trajectory selection at the planning level. The highest level of the hierarchy is a Model Predictive Path Integral (MPPI) control-style planner that determines optimal trajectories and passes these waypoints to a pretrained low-level reinforcement learning (RL) controller. Rather than drawing from an explicit cost map, our MPPI planner leverages the value function of the RL controller as an implicit cost representation. In this formulation, MPPI serves as a trajectory exploration mechanism, while the low-level controller's value function guides the search. To account for the distribution shift seen by the value function between training and evaluation, we propose an online policy evaluation process that adapts the value function to unseen driving experiences, and we demonstrate this adaptation in unseen off-road simulation environments. We evaluate our approach in a high-fidelity off-road driving simulator across a range of challenging terrain conditions and compare its performance against a baseline MPPI controller. The results demonstrate that our method achieves safer and more effective navigation to goal locations while eliminating the need for explicit cost maps and enabling tighter coupling between planning and control.
tldr: This paper proposes a hierarchical off-road autonomous navigation framework that integrates an MPPI planner with a pretrained RL controller, using the controller's value function as an implicit cost map and introducing online policy evaluation to adapt to distribution shift, achieving safer and more effective navigation without explicit cost maps.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种分层越野自主导航框架，将MPPI规划器与预训练的强化学习控制器集成，利用控制器的价值函数作为隐式成本图，并引入在线策略评估以适应分布偏移，在无显式成本图的情况下实现更安全有效的导航。
summary_zh: 越野地形中的自主导航通常采用分层控制与规划架构，该架构依赖显式代价地图以及从高层规划器到低层控制器单向信息流，从而将规划与控制过程中实际执行代价解耦。我们提出了一种分层规划与控制框架，其中信息双向流动，允许低层控制器在规划层面引导轨迹选择。该层次结构的最高层是一个模型预测路径积分（MPPI）控制风格的规划器，用于确定最优轨迹并将这些路点传递给预训练的低层强化学习（RL）控制器。我们的MPPI规划器并非从显式代价地图中获取信息，而是利用RL控制器的价值函数作为隐式代价表示。在这一形式化中，MPPI充当轨迹探索机制，而低层控制器的价值函数则引导搜索。为了应对价值函数在训练与评估之间所见的分布偏移，我们提出了一种在线策略评估过程，使价值函数能够适应未见的驾驶经验，并在未见的越野仿真环境中展示了这种适应性。我们在高保真越野驾驶仿真器中，在一系列具有挑战性的地形条件下评估了我们的方法，并将其性能与基线MPPI控制器进行了比较。结果表明，我们的方法在无需显式代价地图的同时，实现了更安全、更有效地导航至目标位置，并促成了规划与控制之间更紧密的耦合。

title: Explore Where It Matters: Targeted Exploration for Efficient Rover Adaptation
summary: Future planetary rovers will traverse steep, deformable terrain where slip, sinkage, and terrain deformation can threaten mobility. Although simulation can capture some wheel-soil effects, unmodeled deformable-terrain phenomena create sim-to-real gaps requiring deployment-time adaptation. Yet, rover operations leave little room for extensive trial-and-error. We introduce TERRA (Targeted Exploration for Reward-Relevant Adaptation), an online adaptation framework that efficiently seeks deployment data exposing task-relevant model errors and corrects them. TERRA adapts a simulation-trained world model with a reward-weighted prediction loss and trains a loss predictor to estimate where future performance-relevant errors are likely to occur, using this signal to guide exploration during MPC. In simulation, TERRA reaches approximately 90% slope-climbing success within five trials under severe out-of-distribution pretraining conditions, outperforming exploration baselines in reward, completion time, and energy to first success. On the ERNEST rover, TERRA recovers coordinated active-suspension locomotion on a deformable Mars-simulant slope within three to five real-world trials. Project website: https://terra-explore.github.io
tldr: TERRA is an online adaptation framework that uses reward-weighted prediction loss and a learned loss predictor to guide targeted exploration for adapting a simulation-trained world model to real planetary rovers on deformable terrain. It achieves ~90% slope-climbing success in simulation within five trials and recovers active-suspension locomotion on the ERNEST rover within three to five real-world trials.
tldr_zh: TERRA是一种在线自适应框架，通过奖励加权预测损失和学习到的损失预测器来引导定向探索，使仿真训练的世界模型适应真实行星漫游车在可变形地形上的任务。在仿真中五次试验内达到约90%爬坡成功率，并在ERNEST漫游车上三到五次真实试验内恢复主动悬架运动。
