summary_zh: 未来的行星巡视器将在陡峭、可变形的地形上行驶，在这些地形中，打滑、下陷以及地形变形可能对机动性构成威胁。尽管仿真能够捕捉部分轮土相互作用效应，但未建模的可变形地形现象仍会造成仿真与真实环境之间的差距，需要在部署阶段进行适应性调整。然而，巡视器操作几乎没有留出大量试错的空间。我们提出了TERRA（面向奖励相关适应的定向探索），这是一种在线适应框架，能够高效地寻找暴露任务相关模型误差的部署数据并对其加以修正。TERRA采用奖励加权预测损失来适应仿真训练的世界模型，并训练一个损失预测器来估计未来可能出现性能相关误差的位置，并利用该信号在MPC过程中引导探索。在仿真中，即使面对严重的分布外预训练条件，TERRA也能在五次试验内达到约90%的爬坡成功率，在奖励、完成时间以及首次成功所需能量方面均优于其他探索基线。在ERNEST巡视器上，TERRA在可变形火星模拟斜坡上仅通过三到五次真实世界试验便恢复了协调的主动悬架运动能力。项目网站：https://terra-explore.github.io

title: LiDAR-SHIELD: A Fully Dockerized Adversarial Robustness Assessment Framework for LiDAR-Based 3D Perception Models
summary: LiDAR-based 3D perception underpins autonomous driving and robotics, yet deploying these models safely requires stress-testing them against adversarial inputs before real-world use. Although state-of-the-art adversarial attacks exist, their implementations are often fragmented across individual repositories, each tied to a specific architecture or task and requiring manual environment reconstruction and model-specific integration code. We present LIDARSHIELD, a unified and fully Dockerized framework that reverses this workflow: rather than installing the target model inside the toolkit, LIDARSHIELD exposes any model through three lightweight HTTP endpoints, namely /info, /forward, and /gradient As a result, connecting a new model or dataset requires only a single loader function or adapter. The framework supports both 3D semantic segmentation and 3D object detection through the same engine-service protocol, integrating a task-aware suite of state-of-the-art attacks, including PGD and Square Attack for segmentation, and point perturbation, point removal, point injection, and LiDAttack for detection. This enables systematic exposure of corner cases and vulnerabilities across heterogeneous LiDAR backbones. The LiDAR-Shield codebase is publicly available at https://github.com/alexandrosgk/LiDAR-shield.
tldr: LiDAR-SHIELD is a Dockerized, unified framework for adversarial robustness assessment of LiDAR-based 3D perception models, exposing models via HTTP endpoints to support semantic segmentation and object detection attacks. It aims to simplify stress-testing for autonomous driving and robotics applications.
tldr_zh: LiDAR-SHIELD 是一个容器化的统一框架，用于评估基于 LiDAR 的 3D 感知模型的对抗鲁棒性，通过 HTTP 端点暴露模型，支持语义分割和目标检测攻击，旨在简化自动驾驶和机器人应用中的压力测试。
summary_zh: 基于LiDAR的3D感知是自动驾驶和机器人技术的基石，然而，在真实世界部署这些模型之前，必须通过对抗性输入对其进行压力测试以确保安全。尽管已有最先进的对抗性攻击方法，但它们的实现往往分散在各个独立的代码库中，每个都绑定特定的架构或任务，需要手动重建环境并编写特定模型的集成代码。我们提出LIDARSHIELD，一个统一且完全Docker化的框架，它颠覆了这一流程：LIDARSHIELD并非在工具包内部安装目标模型，而是通过三个轻量级HTTP端点（即/info、/forward和/gradient）暴露任意模型。因此，接入新模型或数据集仅需一个加载函数或适配器。该框架通过同一引擎-服务协议支持3D语义分割和3D目标检测，集成了任务感知的最先进攻击套件，包括针对分割任务的PGD和Square Attack，以及针对检测任务的点扰动、点删除、点注入和LiDAttack。这使得能够系统地揭示异构LiDAR主干网络中的边界案例和漏洞。LiDAR-Shield代码库公开于https://github.com/alexandrosgk/LiDAR-shield。

title: Context Compaction for World Models
summary: World models let observers explore and interact with generated worlds. Recent work shows that when observers revisit a region, current models often fail to regenerate it consistently. We view this as a context retrieval problem. LLM agents manage context retrieval at two layers of their stack. At the model layer, the KV cache design determines how much context fits in memory. At the agent harness layer, harnesses such as Claude Code pick the context sent to the LLM. Prior work on world models has mostly focused only on the model layer. In this paper, we make three contributions. First, we build a benchmark to measure world model context retrieval. It generates new worlds for every episode, preventing a model from recalling rooms using training data. It also separates context retrieval from guesses based on nearby frames. Second, we build an agent harness that performs context compaction for world models, which to our knowledge no prior work has studied. Third, we use our benchmark to study four world model designs. Context compaction lets our world models retrieve rooms up to 4 times beyond their context window without retraining. However, world models with sliding-window attention lose most of their context retrieval when dreaming. Therefore, a dreaming world agent benefits more from extending the reach of its world model using context compaction than switching to sliding window attention at the model layer.
tldr: This paper introduces a benchmark and an agent harness for context compaction in world models, demonstrating that context compaction allows world models to retrieve rooms up to 4 times beyond their context window without retraining, while sliding-window attention suffers during dreaming.
tldr_zh: 本文为世界模型提出了上下文压缩的基准测试和智能体框架，证明上下文压缩使世界模型无需重新训练即可在上下文窗口之外检索房间至多4倍，而滑动窗口注意力在梦境生成时会丢失大部分上下文检索能力。
summary_zh: 世界模型让观察者能够探索生成的世界并与之互动。近期研究表明，当观察者故地重游时，现有模型往往难以保持场景生成的一致性。我们将此视为一个上下文检索问题。大语言模型智能体在其架构的两个层面管理上下文检索。在模型层面，KV缓存设计决定了内存中可容纳的上下文量。在智能体框架层面，诸如Claude Code等框架负责选择发送给大语言模型的上下文。以往关于世界模型的研究大多仅关注模型层面。本文做出三点贡献。首先，我们构建了一个基准来评估世界模型的上下文检索能力。该基准为每个回合生成全新世界，防止模型通过训练数据回忆房间场景，同时将上下文检索与基于邻近帧的猜测区分开来。其次，我们构建了一个智能体框架，实现了针对世界模型的上下文压缩功能，据我们所知，此前尚无相关研究。第三，我们利用该基准研究了四种世界模型设计。上下文压缩使我们的世界模型能够在无需重新训练的情况下，检索超出其上下文窗口4倍范围的场景。然而，采用滑动窗口注意力的世界模型在梦境生成时几乎丧失了大部分上下文检索能力。因此，相较于在模型层面切换至滑动窗口注意力，梦境世界智能体通过上下文压缩来扩展其世界模型的覆盖范围能获得更大收益。

title: WorldProbe: When Video World Models Fall Apart under Long-Horizon Spatial Exploration
summary: Video world models generate future visual observations from camera or action inputs, with the goal of synthesizing persistent 3D worlds that can be explored across time and space. Existing benchmarks typically evaluate short interactions or rely on camera trajectories fixed before generation. The performance of video world models under long-horizon exploration with extensive camera motion remains under-explored. We introduce WorldProbe, a diagnostic benchmark that uses a goal-conditioned multimodal agent to adapt camera actions online during generation. WorldProbe comprises 164 test cases across four probing families. Across 10 state-of-the-art models, we generate more than 1,600 rollouts totaling approximately 800 minutes, with horizons up to 180 seconds. Our evaluation across four dimensions reveals both the degradation of local measures and the emergence of long-range inconsistencies. We find that recent models sustain visual and content quality for longer, while long-range memory and evolution remain weak. These results expose a gap between locally stable generation and persistent world consistency that is largely missed by existing benchmarks. Code and benchmark resources are available at https://github.com/Untitled-W/WorldProbe.
tldr: WorldProbe introduces a diagnostic benchmark for evaluating video world models under long-horizon, goal-conditioned camera exploration, revealing that state-of-the-art models maintain local visual quality but suffer from long-range inconsistencies and weak memory, highlighting a critical evaluation gap.
tldr_zh: WorldProbe提出了一个诊断基准，用于评估视频世界模型在长期目标导向相机探索中的表现，揭示了最先进模型能保持局部视觉质量但在长期一致性上存在不足，突显了现有评估的空白。
summary_zh: 视频世界模型根据相机或动作输入生成未来的视觉观测，其目标在于合成可随时间和空间进行探索的持久三维世界。现有基准测试通常评估短时间交互，或依赖于在生成前固定好的相机轨迹。视频世界模型在长时间探索及大幅度相机运动条件下的表现仍未得到充分研究。为此，我们引入了WorldProbe，一种诊断性基准测试，利用基于目标条件的多模态智能体在生成过程中在线调整相机动作。WorldProbe包含四个探测家族下的164个测试案例。针对10种最先进的模型，我们生成了超过1,600条轨迹，总时长约800分钟，最长水平达180秒。我们的评估涵盖四个维度，既揭示了局部度量指标的下滑，也展示了远距离不一致性的出现。研究发现，近期模型在视觉及内容质量上能维持更长时间，但其长期记忆与演化能力依然薄弱。这些结果表明，局部稳定生成与持续世界一致性之间仍存在差距，而这一点在现有基准测试中大多被忽视。相关代码及基准资源可在https://github.com/Untitled-W/WorldProbe获取。

title: Structural-Test Geometry as an Inductive Bias for Partially Observable World Models
summary: Predictive world-model objectives need not organize latent histories according to distinctions required for later control. With privileged simulator access during training, should response-derived structural information be predicted, decoded, or imposed directly on latent geometry--and how do these choices compare with structured belief distillation? We define posterior-marginalized structural tests whose response distributions induce a pseudometric over histories, then train quotient-preserving (QP) world models by aligning shared latent Euclidean distances to that metric. Across a fixed six-task diagnostic suite, the largest differences appear under held-out structural variation: QP improves planning success by 26.1 points $[21.5,30.7]$ over metric decoding and 6.4 points $[3.8,9.0]$ over structured belief distillation. On GridWorld, metric decoding accurately recovers held-out structural distances ($ρ=.91$) while its native latent geometry remains more distorted than QP's (paired IQD difference $.22$ $[.20,.24]$), showing that relational recoverability and direct geometric alignment can diverge.
tldr: This paper investigates how to impose structural information from privileged simulator access onto latent geometries of partially observable world models, proposing quotient-preserving (QP) world models that align latent distances to a posterior-marginalized structural-test pseudometric. QP improves planning success and geometric alignment over metric decoding and structured belief distillation on a six-task diagnostic suite.
tldr_zh: 本文研究如何在部分可观测世界模型的潜在几何上施加来自特权模拟器访问的结构信息，提出通过将潜在距离对齐到后验边缘化结构测试伪度量来训练商保持（QP）世界模型。在六任务诊断套件中，QP在规划成功率和几何对齐上优于度量解码和结构化信念蒸馏。
summary_zh: 预测性世界模型的目标并不需要根据后续控制所需的各种区分来组织潜在历史。在训练期间拥有特权模拟器访问权限时，响应衍生的结构信息应当被预测、解码，还是直接施加于潜在几何结构之上——这些选择与结构化信念蒸馏相比又如何？我们定义了后验边缘化的结构测试，其响应分布诱导出历史之上的伪度量，然后通过将共享潜在欧氏距离与该度量对齐，训练保持商结构（QP）的世界模型。在固定的六任务诊断套件中，最大的差异出现在保留的结构变化下：QP在规划成功率上比度量解码提高了26.1个百分点$[21.5,30.7]$，比结构化信念蒸馏提高了6.4个百分点$[3.8,9.0]$。在GridWorld中，度量解码能够准确恢复保留的结构距离（$ρ=.91$），而其原生潜在几何结构的畸变程度仍高于QP（配对IQD差异$.22$ $[.20,.24]$），这表明关系可恢复性与直接几何对齐可能会产生分歧。

title: Geometric Time Score Estimators: Bridging Self-Predictive Representations and Generative Occupancy Models For Reinforcement Learning
summary: In reinforcement learning (RL), temporal reasoning is essential for estimating the density of future outcomes under a policy's occupancy measure. While self-predictive representations have been a dominant paradigm for occupancy density estimation, we find that they yield surprisingly poor estimates. On the other hand, generative occupancy models can produce remarkably accurate samples from the occupancy measure. Yet, they cannot easily recover occupancy densities, limiting their use for control despite their expressivity. In this paper, we propose Geometric Time Score Estimators (GTSE), a framework that bridges the two paradigms by learning occupancy density estimators along probability paths. We analyze how GTSE implicitly induces better occupancy estimators through improved representation learning and show how to directly extract self-predictive representations from this framework. Through experiments across several locomotion and manipulation tasks, we show that GTSE improves performance over state-of-the-art methods by $2\times$ to $6\times$ in goal-conditioned RL settings, and that the representations learned using our framework transfer effectively to downstream RL tasks. Website: https://aravindvenu7.github.io/website/gtse/
tldr: The paper introduces Geometric Time Score Estimators (GTSE), a framework that bridges self-predictive representations and generative occupancy models to improve occupancy density estimation and reinforcement learning performance on locomotion and manipulation tasks.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了几何时间分数估计器（GTSE），该框架弥合了自预测表示与生成占用模型之间的差距，以改进占用密度估计，并提升运动与操作任务中的强化学习性能。
summary_zh: 在强化学习（RL）中，时间推理对于在策略占用度量下估计未来结果的密度至关重要。尽管自预测表征一直是占用密度估计的主导范式，但我们发现它们产生的估计出奇地差。另一方面，生成式占用模型可以从占用度量中生成非常准确的样本。然而，它们难以恢复占用密度，这限制了它们在控制中的应用，尽管其具有强大的表达能力。在本文中，我们提出了几何时间分数估计器（GTSE），这是一个通过学习沿概率路径的占用密度估计器来弥合两种范式的框架。我们分析了GTSE如何通过改进表征学习隐式地诱导更好的占用估计器，并展示了如何从该框架中直接提取自预测表征。通过在多个运动和控制任务上的实验，我们表明GTSE在目标条件RL设置中将性能相比最先进方法提升了$2\times$到$6\times$，并且使用我们框架学习到的表征能够有效地迁移到下游RL任务。网站：https://aravindvenu7.github.io/website/gtse/

title: SymAnt: Grounding Long-Horizon Action Anticipation with Adaptable Symbolic Priors
summary: As robots and intelligent systems increasingly interact with humans, they must anticipate long sequences of future actions from only brief observations. While purely neural models typically require extensive observations to predict future actions and remain difficult to interpret and adjust, symbolic priors offer a structured alternative. To this end, we introduce SymAnt, a novel neuro-symbolic approach that unifies the expressiveness of neural networks with the structured reasoning of scene and knowledge graphs. Given a short video, SymAnt performs a joint-search over both graphs to construct a symbolic context, enabling unified reasoning over spatial relationships, object attributes, affordances, and associated actions. This symbolic context serves as a prior for an iterative refinement process that progressively generates and improves the sequence of future actions. By grounding predictions in symbolic context, SymAnt anticipates long-horizon actions from short observation windows in a parameter-efficient manner, while enabling users to directly edit the underlying knowledge to adjust predictions without further training. Through our experiments, we demonstrate the effectiveness of SymAnt, particularly when only short observation contexts are available, across five diverse datasets: Breakfast, 50 Salads, EPIC-KITCHENS, EGTEA Gaze+, and Assembly101.
tldr: SymAnt introduces a neuro-symbolic approach for long-horizon action anticipation from short video observations, jointly searching scene and knowledge graphs to construct a symbolic context that grounds an iterative refinement process for future action prediction. The method is parameter-efficient, interpretable, and allows users to edit symbolic priors without retraining.
tldr_zh: SymAnt提出了一种神经符号方法，通过联合搜索场景图和知识图构建符号上下文，为迭代细化过程提供基础，从而从短视频观察中预测长时程未来动作。该方法参数高效、可解释，并允许用户无需重新训练即可编辑符号先验以调整预测。
summary_zh: 随着机器人和智能系统与人类的互动日益频繁，它们必须仅凭少量观察就能预测未来的长序列动作。然而，纯神经网络模型通常需要大量观察数据来预测未来动作，且难以解释和调整，而符号先验则提供了一种结构化的替代方案。为此，我们提出了SymAnt，一种新颖的神经符号方法，它将神经网络的表达能力与场景图和知识图谱的结构化推理统一起来。给定一段短视频，SymAnt对两种图谱进行联合搜索以构建符号上下文，从而实现对空间关系、物体属性、可供性及相关动作的统一推理。该符号上下文作为迭代精化过程的先验，逐步生成并改进未来动作序列。通过将预测建立在符号上下文之上，SymAnt以参数高效的方式从短观察窗口预测长时程动作，同时允许用户直接编辑底层知识以调整预测，无需进一步训练。通过实验，我们在五个多样化数据集——Breakfast、50 Salads、EPIC-KITCHENS、EGTEA Gaze+和Assembly101——上验证了SymAnt的有效性，尤其是在仅有短观察上下文的情况下。

title: Optimal Path Planning with Localization constraints
summary: This paper studies UAV path planning in areas where GPS signals are not present. Because these drones can easily get lost when they don't have GPS, they must rely on dead reckoning and occasionally pass near cellular towers, which act as landmarks to reset and fix their position. The goal is to find the shortest path from a start to a goal location while keeping the estimation uncertainty within a given bound. To solve this problem, we propose a localization-constrained A* planner that treats uncertainty as a hard constraint during search. The robot state and covariance are propagated using an Extended Kalman Filter (EKF), and only paths that satisfy the covariance limit are considered. We also show that the proposed method does not affect heuristic used in A* and remains admissible and consistent, ensuring optimality among all feasible paths. Extensive Monte Carlo simulations and PyBullet quadrotor test show that the proposed method finds shorter and more reliable paths compared to RRT* and PRM, while always satisfying the uncertainty constraint.
tldr: This paper introduces a localization-constrained A* planner for UAV path planning in GPS-denied environments, treating estimation uncertainty as a hard constraint and using an EKF for covariance propagation, demonstrating shorter and more reliable paths than RRT* and PRM in simulations and PyBullet quadrotor tests.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种在无GPS环境中考虑定位约束的A*无人机路径规划方法，将估计不确定性作为硬约束，并通过EKF传播协方差，在仿真和PyBullet四旋翼实验中相比RRT*和PRM实现了更短且更可靠的路径。
summary_zh: 本文研究了在无GPS信号区域中的无人机路径规划问题。由于这些无人机在没有GPS的情况下很容易迷失方向，因此它们必须依赖航位推算，并偶尔靠近蜂窝基站，将基站作为地标来重置和修正自身位置。目标是在将估计不确定性保持在给定范围内的同时，找到从起点到目标位置的最短路径。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了一种定位约束A*规划器，在搜索过程中将不确定性视为硬约束。机器人状态和协方差通过扩展卡尔曼滤波器（EKF）进行传播，并且仅考虑满足协方差限制的路径。我们还证明了所提方法不会影响A*中使用的启发式函数，并且保持可采纳性和一致性，从而确保在所有可行路径中的最优性。大量蒙特卡洛仿真和PyBullet四旋翼测试表明，与RRT*和PRM相比，所提方法能够找到更短且更可靠的路径，同时始终满足不确定性约束。

title: MUSBRIC: LEGO-Compatible Pneumatic Muscle Bricks for Reconfigurable Musculoskeletal Robots
summary: Musculoskeletal robots combine compliant actuators with articulated skeletons, but exploring alternative configurations often requires repeated fabrication. We present MUSBRIC, a modular hardware platform and accompanying MuJoCo-based simulator for reconfigurable musculoskeletal robots. LEGO-compatible endcaps turn fiber-reinforced extensile pneumatic artificial muscles into reusable, plug-and-play muscle bricks that connect directly to standard LEGO components. Experimentally identified actuator behavior supports corresponding musculoskeletal simulations. An elbow-joint prototype validates load-dependent flexion and extension, showing that pulley-guided routing enables reversible motion and a mechanical stop stabilizes the straight posture. A robotic hand demonstrates compliant grasping and multi-joint construction. Matched hardware and simulation sweeps across 15 leg configurations demonstrate systematic exploration of attachment geometry, while a quadruped assembled from four legs demonstrates walking. Together, these demonstrations span mechanism analysis, configuration exploration, and functional robot construction within a single reconfigurable system. The hardware designs and simulation code will be released as open source soon to facilitate reproduction and further development.
tldr: MUSBRIC introduces LEGO-compatible pneumatic muscle bricks and a MuJoCo simulator for rapidly reconfigurable musculoskeletal robots, demonstrated on an elbow joint, robotic hand, and quadruped.
tldr_zh: MUSBRIC 提出与乐高兼容的气动肌肉积木及配套 MuJoCo 仿真器，用于快速重构肌肉骨骼机器人，并展示了肘关节、机械手与四足机器人。
summary_zh: 肌肉骨骼机器人将柔性执行器与关节骨架相结合，但探索替代构型往往需要反复制造。我们提出了MUSBRIC，一个模块化硬件平台及配套的基于MuJoCo的仿真器，用于可重构肌肉骨骼机器人。与LEGO兼容的端盖将纤维增强伸展型气动人工肌肉转变为可重复使用、即插即用的肌肉砖块，可直接连接到标准LEGO组件。实验表征的执行器行为支持相应的肌肉骨骼仿真。一个肘关节原型验证了载荷相关的屈伸运动，表明滑轮引导走线可实现可逆运动，机械限位可稳定伸直姿态。一只机器人手展示了柔性抓取和多关节构建。在15种腿部构型上进行的硬件与仿真匹配扫描展示了连接几何的系统化探索，而由四条腿组装而成的四足机器人展示了行走功能。这些演示共同涵盖了单一可重构系统内的机构分析、构型探索和功能机器人构建。硬件设计和仿真代码将很快作为开源发布，以促进复现和进一步开发。

title: CuBot-STT: Simultaneously Transport and Tighten for Lattice-type Modular Reconfiguration Robot
summary: Lattice-type modular reconfigurable robots rearrange standardized modules across tasks. Dedicated transport robots reduce module weight and cost by eliminating module level reconfiguration actuators. But existing systems use low capacity connections or internal fastening robots that occupy space for functional components. This paper presents CuBot-STT, which integrates module transport, interface locking, and release in one external robot. Cubic modules provide structural support and $24\,\mathrm{V}$ power distribution. On each face, a gear transmission converts one external input into motion of four helical locking points, preserving internal space. The robot uses alternating foot support, a gripper for module handling, and a tightening head for interface actuation. The controller coordinates two-foot support and module locking through continuous constraint transfers. The planner decomposes relocation costs into an analytical lower bound and a residual learned through expert-guided, goal conditioned Q-learning. Contact face $A^*$ search expands relocation sequences into robot primitives satisfying connectivity, asymmetric manipulation, and foot stance constraints. Experiments demonstrate normal and tangential interface capacities of $300\,\mathrm{N}$ and $490\,\mathrm{N}$, electrical continuity across six modules, and autonomous reconfiguration of an 11-module lattice. Planning benchmarks show superior search efficiency over analytical guidance and bidirectional heuristic search, with generalization beyond training lattice sizes without fine-tuning.
tldr: CuBot-STT is an external robot that simultaneously transports and tightens lattice-type modular reconfigurable robot modules, integrating locking and release with a learned planner for autonomous reconfiguration.
tldr_zh: CuBot-STT 是一种外置机器人，可同时完成晶格型模块化可重构机器人的模块运输与锁紧，并结合学习规划器实现自主重构。
summary_zh:
摘要：
晶格型模块化可重构机器人通过在不同任务中重新布置标准化模块来适应需求。专用运输机器人通过取消模块级重构执行器来降低模块重量和成本。但现有系统采用低承载能力连接，或使用会占用功能部件空间的内部紧固机器人。本文提出CuBot-STT，将模块运输、接口锁定与释放集成于一个外部机器人中。立方体模块提供结构支撑和$24\,\mathrm{V}$配电。在每个面上，齿轮传动将单一路外部输入转换为四个螺旋锁点的运动，从而保留内部空间。该机器人采用交替足部支撑、用于模块操作的夹爪以及用于接口驱动的拧紧头。控制器通过连续约束转移来协调双脚支撑与模块锁定。规划器将重定位成本分解为解析下界和通过专家引导、目标条件Q学习获得的残差。接触面$A^*$搜索将重定位序列扩展为满足连通性、非对称操作和足部站姿约束的机器人原语。实验表明，接口法向和切向承载能力分别为$300\,\mathrm{N}$和$490\,\mathrm{N}$，六个模块间实现电气连续性，并可自主重构一个11模块晶格。规划基准测试表明，其搜索效率优于解析引导和双向启发式搜索，并且无需微调即可泛化到训练晶格尺寸之外。

title: EmbodiExp: Compositional Experience Transfer for Embodied Agents
summary: Experience can help embodied agents turn high-level plans into grounded actions, but transferring it across tasks remains challenging: previously effective strategies may be inapplicable to the current state or fail to produce their intended outcomes. We present EmbodiExp, a framework for constructing transferable experiences and composing them online during embodied task execution. Our key observation is that tasks often share subgoals whose completion can be assessed independently of overall task success. We therefore introduce an outcome-grounded subgoal experience that specifies a subgoal, applicability conditions, an adaptable policy, and a verifiable outcome. During execution, applicable experiences guide action generation, while verified outcomes can establish the conditions required by subsequent experiences, enabling online composition. Subgoal-level outcome attribution further enables failure utilization: failed trajectories can still contribute verified local successes and condition-specific guidance on actions to avoid. Experiments on multiple embodied benchmarks under a fold-based protocol with frozen experience banks demonstrate the effectiveness of EmbodiExp.
tldr: EmbodiExp introduces a framework for transferring and composing outcome-grounded subgoal experiences online during embodied task execution, enabling effective experience transfer and failure utilization across tasks.
tldr_zh: EmbodiExp 提出了一种框架，用于在具身任务执行过程中在线转移和组合基于结果的目标子经验，从而实现跨任务的有效经验迁移和失败利用。
summary_zh: 经验能够帮助具身智能体将高层规划转化为实际行动，但如何在不同任务间迁移经验仍具挑战性：先前有效的策略可能不适用于当前状态，或无法产生预期结果。我们提出EmbodiExp框架，用于构建可迁移经验并在具身任务执行过程中在线组合这些经验。我们的关键观察是，任务往往共享子目标，而这些子目标的完成情况可以独立于整体任务成功与否进行评估。为此，我们引入一种基于结果锚定的子目标经验，该经验包含子目标定义、适用条件、可调整策略以及可验证的结果。在执行过程中，适用的经验指导动作生成，而验证通过的结果可建立后续经验所需的条件，从而实现在线组合。子目标层面的结果归因还进一步支持失败利用：失败的轨迹仍可贡献已验证的局部成功，并提供针对应避免动作的情境化指导。我们在多种具身基准上采用折叠协议并冻结经验库进行实验，结果验证了EmbodiExp的有效性。

title: Video Generation Meets Agent Harness: Agentic Video Generation, Agentic World Modeling and Recursive Self-Improvement
summary: Video generation is shifting from end-to-end synthesis toward agentic generation, where planning, tool use, and feedback enable coherent, controllable multi-shot videos. In parallel, video world models provide action-conditioned observations and predicted futures, serving as interactive environments for agents. We study their intersection through the agent harness: an executable runtime that constructs context, exposes tools, maintains state, routes feedback, and manages budgets around video models. This report examines three directions. First, agentic video generation, where harnesses coordinate scripting, shot planning, asset management, production, and editing, alongside the evaluation challenges of these systems. Second, agentic world modeling, where harnesses mediate observation, control, execution, and state. We discuss hybrid designs in which game engines or agent-written programs maintain world state while video models render observations, and how agents and world models can mutually evaluate and improve one another. Third, recursive self-improvement (RSI) in video model development, distinguishing output revisions, updates to harness state, generator parameters, and evaluators, and changes to the improvement procedure itself. We identify how these improvements feed back into subsequent development. Across these directions, we analyze essential agent capabilities, including audiovisual perception, long-horizon planning, memory, code-based interaction, feedback-guided control, skill reuse, and multi-agent coordination. We conclude with challenges in autonomous video production, lifelong memory, programmable hybrid control, autonomous model development, provenance, cost accounting, and evaluation linking video quality and task performance to sustained improvements in models and harnesses.
tldr: This report explores the intersection of video generation and agent harnesses, covering agentic video generation, agentic world modeling, and recursive self-improvement for video models and agentic systems.
tldr_zh: 本报告探讨了视频生成与智能体框架的交叉领域，涵盖代理式视频生成、代理式世界建模以及视频模型与智能体系统的递归自我改进。
summary_zh: 视频生成正从端到端合成转向智能体驱动生成，其中规划、工具使用和反馈机制使得连贯、可控的多镜头视频成为可能。与此同时，视频世界模型提供基于动作条件的观测和未来预测，充当智能体的交互环境。我们通过智能体框架（Agent Harness）来研究二者的交汇点：一个可执行运行时，围绕视频模型构建上下文、暴露工具、维护状态、路由反馈并管理预算。本报告探讨三个方向。其一是智能体视频生成，框架协调脚本编写、镜头规划、资产管理、制作与剪辑，同时探讨这些系统的评估挑战。其二是智能体世界建模，框架在观测、控制、执行和状态之间进行中介。我们讨论混合设计，即游戏引擎或智能体编写的程序维护世界状态，而视频模型渲染观测结果，并探讨智能体与世界模型如何相互评估和改进。其三是视频模型开发中的递归自我改进（RSI），区分输出修订、框架状态更新、生成器参数与评估器的变更，以及改进流程本身的调整。我们分析这些改进如何反馈到后续开发中。围绕上述方向，我们剖析智能体的关键能力，包括视听感知、长视野规划、记忆、基于代码的交互、反馈引导控制、技能复用以及多智能体协同。最后，我们总结在自主视频制作、终身记忆、可编程混合控制、自主模型开发、溯源、成本核算以及将视频质量与任务表现关联至模型和框架持续改进的评估等方面所面临的挑战。

title: GROME: GROunding Factorized MEmory into Video World Models
summary: Long-horizon consistency is essential for video world models, yet it becomes difficult to maintain once observed content falls outside the context window. Existing memory mechanisms either retrieve history as implicit context, which remains constrained by context capacity and entangles static and dynamic information or consolidate history into explicit global representations, which struggle to model evolving dynamics and accumulate geometric errors. To overcome these limitations, we introduce \textbf{GROME}, a novel factorized memory framework that augments video world models for long-horizon coherence across both static scenes and dynamic entities. GROME operates via three synergistic components: 1)~\emph{Static-Dynamic Factorization} decouples historical evidence into static and dynamic components, preserving static scene geometry and dynamic entity states separately; 2)~\emph{Local Memory Retrieval} selects spatially aligned static history to eliminate geometric drift alongside the latest dynamic entity states to ensure temporal continuity; 3)~\emph{Training-Free Memory Injection} seamlessly grounds the factorized memory into video world models via their native conditioning pathways. Experiments on long-horizon revisit scenarios demonstrate that GROME substantially enhances scene persistence and dynamic entity fidelity over existing methods, all while preserving the visual quality and controllability of the frozen backbone without additional training. Beyond self-rollouts, GROME readily accommodates external observations as plug-and-play memory, unlocking flexible and controllable video continuation and scene exploration.
tldr: GROME introduces a factorized memory framework for video world models that decouples static scene geometry from dynamic entity states, enabling long-horizon coherence and controllable video continuation without training.
tldr_zh: GROME提出了一种面向视频世界模型的因子化记忆框架，将静态场景几何与动态实体状态解耦，无需训练即可实现长时程连贯性与可控视频续写。
summary_zh: 长程一致性对于视频世界模型至关重要，然而一旦观测内容超出上下文窗口，这种一致性便难以维持。现有的记忆机制要么将历史信息作为隐式上下文进行检索，但这仍受限于上下文容量，并将静态信息与动态信息纠缠在一起；要么将历史信息整合为显式的全局表示，但这种方式难以建模演化的动态，且会累积几何误差。为克服上述局限，我们提出**GROME**，一种新颖的分解式记忆框架，用于增强视频世界模型在静态场景与动态实体上的长程一致性。GROME通过三个协同组件运作：1）\emph{静-动态分解}将历史证据解耦为静态与动态两个组成部分，分别保留静态场景几何与动态实体状态；2）\emph{局部记忆检索}选取空间对齐的静态历史以消除几何漂移，并结合最新的动态实体状态以保证时间连续性；3）\emph{免训练记忆注入}通过视频世界模型原生的条件通路，将分解后的记忆无缝嵌入其中。在长程重访场景上的实验表明，相较于现有方法，GROME显著提升了场景持久性与动态实体保真度，同时在不进行额外训练的情况下，保持了冻结骨干网络的视觉质量与可控性。除自回归生成外，GROME还可将外部观测轻松纳入作为即插即用记忆，从而支持灵活且可控的视频续写与场景探索。

title: FutureWorld: A Plug-and-Play Causal Next-State Predictor for Interactive Video World Exploration
summary: Interactive video world models aim to follow user actions while maintaining scene consistency over extended interactions. History-based methods reuse generated latents to preserve scene content, but three limitations of this reuse contribute to error recirculation. 1) The latent generated at each interaction is retained as history, potentially containing blurred details, geometric distortions, or semantic drift. 2) Although retrieved historical content matches the current scene, it can still contain errors that are carried into the next chunk. 3) New outputs then become history for later interactions, potentially reinforcing the same errors through repeated reuse. To limit this cycle, we aim to predict the future scene state from the current generated latent and the next action before generating the next interaction's video chunk. This future-state prior provides guidance for the next chunk, with the aim of reducing the errors carried forward from history. To this end, we propose a plug-and-play Causal Next-Chunk Predictor (C-NCP) with cross-model adaptability and prediction-guided modulation. We integrate C-NCP into four base generators and evaluate the augmented models across three benchmarks for interactive long-video generation and action-conditioned world modeling. Extensive experiments demonstrate reduced error accumulation and improved long-horizon consistency across diverse generation settings. The project page is at https://GuangYuanKK.github.io/futureworld.
tldr: This paper addresses error accumulation in interactive video world models by introducing a plug-and-play Causal Next-Chunk Predictor (C-NCP) that predicts future scene states to guide generation, improving long-horizon consistency.
tldr_zh: 本文针对交互式视频世界模型中的误差累积问题，提出了一种即插即用的因果下一块预测器（C-NCP），通过预测未来场景状态来指导生成，从而提高长时程一致性。
summary_zh: 交互式视频世界模型旨在遵循用户动作的同时，在长时间交互中保持场景一致性。基于历史的方法通过重用生成的潜变量来保持场景内容，但这种重用存在三个局限，导致误差循环传播。1）每次交互生成的潜变量被保留为历史，其中可能包含模糊细节、几何畸变或语义漂移。2）尽管检索到的历史内容与当前场景匹配，但仍可能含有误差，并被带入下一片段。3）新的输出随后成为后续交互的历史，可能通过反复重用而加剧相同误差。为限制这一循环，我们旨在根据当前生成的潜变量和下一个动作，在生成下一交互视频片段之前预测未来场景状态。该未来状态先验为下一片段提供引导，以减少从历史中累积传递的误差。为此，我们提出了一种即插即用的因果下一片段预测器（C-NCP），具有跨模型适应性和预测引导调制能力。我们将C-NCP集成到四个基础生成器中，并在三个基准上评估增强模型，用于交互式长视频生成和动作条件世界建模。大量实验表明，该方法在多种生成设置下有效减少了误差累积，并提升了长程一致性。项目页面位于 https://GuangYuanKK.github.io/futureworld。

title: Robust LIDAR Sensor-to-Sensor Domain Generalization via Accumulated-Point Scene Completion
summary:
We study domain generalization for LIDAR semantic segmentation. Deep neural networks achieve strong performance on 3D point clouds, yet real-world LIDAR exhibits sensor-specific sampling patterns that hinder transfer across datasets. In many applications, performance on completely unseen sensors is crucial. A model should preferably work on a new setup without prior access to its data or labels. To this end, we introduce a source-only training scheme that adds an occupancy prediction auxiliary objective. We aggregate source-domain scans into a simple world model and use it as the supervision signal, replacing single-scan standard segmentation training.
  A key property of our approach is that it does not alter the input scan. During training and testing the network consumes the same single-frame LIDAR input, only the supervision signal is enriched via the occupancy objective. At deployment, there is no runtime overhead as the auxiliary head can be dropped for pure segmentation, or kept to obtain scene completion alongside semantic segmentation. In an experimental evaluation across distinct LIDAR datasets, we demonstrate that a model's generalization to new domains can be significantly affected by how it is supervised. In certain setups, performance on unseen domains improves without any explicit domain adaptation (no target scans, no target labels, no sensor priors) and without prediction refinement. At the same time, our method maintains competitive source-domain segmentation performance and incurs no additional inference cost.
tldr: This paper introduces a source-only training scheme for LIDAR semantic segmentation that adds an occupancy prediction auxiliary objective using accumulated point cloud data to improve domain generalization to unseen sensors without extra runtime cost.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种仅使用源域数据的训练方案，通过添加基于累积点云的占用预测辅助目标，提高激光雷达语义分割对未知传感器的泛化能力，且不增加推理开销。
summary_zh:
我们研究了激光雷达语义分割的域泛化问题。深度神经网络在三维点云上表现出强大的性能，然而现实世界中的激光雷达具有传感器特有的采样模式，这阻碍了跨数据集的迁移。在许多应用场景中，模型在完全未见过的传感器上的表现至关重要。理想的模型应能在不事先获取新设备数据或标签的情况下直接运行。为此，我们引入了一种仅使用源域数据的训练方案，该方案增加了一个占用预测辅助目标。我们将源域扫描聚合为一个简单的世界模型，并将其作为监督信号，替代了单次扫描的标准分割训练。

我们方法的一个关键特性是它不改变输入扫描数据。在训练和测试期间，网络处理的是相同的单帧激光雷达输入，仅仅是监督信号通过占用目标得到了丰富。在部署阶段，不存在运行时开销，因为辅助头可以被移除以进行纯分割，也可以保留以在语义分割的同时获得场景补全。在跨不同激光雷达数据集的实验评估中，我们证明了模型的跨域泛化能力会受到监督方式的显著影响。在某些设置下，在没有任何显式域适应（无目标扫描、无目标标签、无传感器先验）且不进行预测精炼的情况下，模型在未见域上的性能得到了提升。同时，我们的方法保持了具有竞争力的源域分割性能，且不产生额外的推理成本。

title: Adaptive search with path-constrained mobile sensors using multi-arm bandits
summary: We study a constrained sequential decision problem for detecting regions of interest from noisy online measurements collected by a team of energy-constrained mobile sensors. The sensor motion is restricted to a precomputed set of feasible paths that satisfy mobility constraints, limited available energy by requiring return to charging stations, and avoidance of known obstacles. We cast the resulting active path selection as a multi-armed bandit problem and propose an iterative search algorithm that adaptively assigns paths using confidence bounds computed from the collected data. We also propose a graph-based method to construct low-cardinality path covers under the team's constraints. We establish finite-time and anytime probabilistic correctness guarantees for the proposed algorithm, derive non-asymptotic upper bounds on the times required to detect all regions of interest and to label all nodes, and show that these bounds match algorithm-independent lower bounds up to constant factors for a broad class of problem instances. Using numerical simulations, we illustrate the behavior of the proposed approach and the effect of path redundancy and team size on search performance.
tldr: This paper addresses adaptive search by a team of energy-constrained mobile sensors using multi-armed bandits, proposing an algorithm with guarantees and path-cover construction for detecting regions of interest.
tldr_zh: 本文研究能量受限的移动传感器团队使用多臂老虎机进行自适应搜索，提出带保证的算法和路径覆盖构造，用于检测感兴趣区域。

title: Decision-Level Error Attribution and Depth-Aware Safety Evaluation of Monocular RGB Human Tracking for Autonomous Robot Navigation
summary: Monocular RGB tracking is useful for robots operating near people, but perception errors affect binary stop/proceed decisions in ways that geometric accuracy metrics do not capture. We examine how much decision error arises from the safety rule versus perception. We prove that lateral-only distance is a lower bound on planar distance: with accurate positions, it cannot miss dangers identified by the planar rule, but it produces unnecessary stops. We introduce a two-factor Shapley attribution separating rule and perception contributions, and further distinguish missed detections from localization errors. Experiments use ETH and UCY pedestrian videos with simulated stationary robots, disjoint calibration and evaluation pedestrians, and time-block bootstrap intervals. Across 898 pedestrians in three scenes, the lateral rule missed no dangers on annotated positions but achieved only 5.6-31.9% stop precision. In two scenes with RGB perception, calibrated ground-plane localization achieved 0.59 m and 0.51 m planar RMSE, compared with 1.72 m and 1.39 m for a geometric baseline and 0.81 m and 0.68 m for calibrated Depth Anything V2. Detection recall of 0.43 and 0.26 made missed detections the leading source of missed danger. A two-standard-deviation safety margin with ground-plane localization matched or improved on the lateral rule's missed-danger rate in all eight scene-threshold settings and reduced unnecessary stops in seven. All robot interactions are simulated, and outcomes are offline decision classifications, not demonstrations of collision avoidance.
tldr: Proposes decision-level error attribution using Shapley values plus depth-calibrated monocular RGB human tracking to evaluate safety stop/proceed rules for robots navigating near people.
tldr_zh: 提出基于Shapley值的决策级误差归因方法，结合深度校准的单目RGB人体跟踪，评估机器人在人群中导航的停止/前进安全规则。

title: Teaching a Tree to Recover: Online Distillation of an LLM Supervisor with Counterfactual Replay
summary: Autonomous mobile robots commonly pair a global planner with a local model predictive controller (MPC), but nonconvex obstacle avoidance and a limited horizon can make the robot freeze in complex layouts. Deciding whether to replan, wait, or call for help is a supervisory decision. Recent work queries a large language model (LLM) supervisor on every anomaly, which is slow and costly. We instead distill the LLM online into a decision tree. After each training episode, counterfactual replay labels recoveries as needed, unnecessary, or harmful. These labels retire unhelpful rules. In simulation, on 20 unseen layouts where the MPC alone freezes, the tree handles at least 18 correctly across all seeds, either by reaching the goal or by calling for help when no feasible path exists. The tree matches both an always-query LLM supervisor and expert-designed rules, while issuing no LLM queries at test time. Handwritten rules cannot anticipate the long tail of situations a physical robot will encounter. Online distillation is a promising remedy: the tree handles familiar cases, and the LLM is consulted only for new ones, whose validated recoveries become new rules. Language models can thus also serve as designers of supervisors rather than only as runtime supervisors.
tldr: The paper distills an LLM supervisor for mobile robot recovery decisions into a decision tree via online counterfactual replay, matching LLM and expert rules without test-time LLM queries.
tldr_zh: 该论文通过在线反事实回放将用于移动机器人恢复决策的LLM监督者蒸馏为决策树，在测试时无需查询LLM即可匹敌LLM监督者和专家规则。

title: Assuring Learning-Enabled Cyber-Physical Systems with Foundation Models: A Neuro-Symbolic Agenda for Testing, Verification, and Runtime Assurance
summary: Learning-enabled cyber-physical systems (CPS), including autonomous vehicles and UAVs, increasingly incorporate foundation models, yet fragmented assurance practices provide insufficient support for system-level guarantees. We argue that restoring engineering control across stochastic neural, symbolic, and physical boundaries requires a shift from model-centric evaluation to system-level assurance. We introduce the Foundation Model Assurance Stack, connecting three directions: (i) neuro-symbolic architectures that constrain foundation models through explicit symbolic world models, reasoning layers, and interfaces; (ii) semantically grounded, conformance-based testing that combines formal specifications and symbolic world models with foundation-model-assisted specification mining, scenario generation, and test synthesis; and (iii) compositional verification and runtime assurance that target formally tractable components and interfaces through modular contracts, equivalence checking, verified synthesis, uncertainty-aware reasoning, and runtime monitoring and enforcement. Symbolic abstractions establish assurance boundaries between stochastic learning and formal reasoning, connecting testing, verification, and runtime evidence across the system lifecycle. Foundation models serve as constrained assistants whose outputs are independently checked wherever correctness can be formally specified. We identify research challenges in specification engineering, abstraction fidelity, evidence composition, and lifecycle certification, and outline a staged agenda toward trustworthy, deployable, and certifiable learning-enabled CPS.
tldr: This paper proposes a neuro-symbolic assurance framework for learning-enabled cyber-physical systems that incorporate foundation models, integrating symbolic world models, conformance-based testing, and compositional verification to ensure system-level safety and certification.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于集成基础模型的学习型信息物理系统的神经符号保证框架，通过符号世界模型、一致性测试和组合验证来确保系统级安全和认证。

title: Inertial Steering and Motion Prediction of Tracked Vehicles on Low-Adherence Surfaces
summary: Tracked vehicles are widely used in off-road applications, but their conventional motion models often rely on no-slip assumptions that become inaccurate on low-adherence surfaces. Rather than treating inertial effects arising from slip as a disturbance to be minimized, this work investigates how inertial effects arising from a moving mass can be deliberately exploited for steering on low-friction surfaces. A dynamic model for an articulated tracked vehicle with a passive trailer is developed, allowing inertial effects from trailer motion to be captured. The approach is experimentally evaluated on ice, where our dynamic model outperforms the kinematic baseline. We also propose a mixed dynamic-kinematic model to adapt predictions to both surface and situation by exploiting predictions from both methods. Finally, we demonstrate inertial steering on a mono-track vehicle without a conventional steering mechanism, showing that controlled movements of an internal mass can generate turning motion on ice. The resulting behavior can be predicted using the proposed dynamic model by representing the internal mass as a frictionless trailer, revealing the analogous dynamics between the two configurations. These results demonstrate the feasibility of inertial steering as an alternative steering mechanism for tracked vehicles operating in low-adherence environments.
tldr: This paper proposes dynamic models and a mixed dynamic-kinematic approach to predict and exploit inertial steering for tracked vehicles on low-adherence surfaces like ice, demonstrating the feasibility of using internal mass movement for turning without a conventional steering mechanism.
tldr_zh: 本文提出动态模型和混合动态-运动学方法，用于预测和利用履带车辆在冰面等低附着路面上的惯性转向，并演示了通过内部质量移动实现无传统转向机构的转向可行性。

title: Cheap Retrieval and Observation Credit Assignment from One Quantity: The Value of Information
summary: Memory in reinforcement learning raises two problems. Attention finds the relevant item by scoring the whole store, which is costly for robots under latency and energy limits. When a retrieved memory pays off, credit for acquiring it must cross the whole sequence. We argue that both are governed by one quantity, the value of information, and propose to estimate it from archived rollouts with a learned world model. We obtain that, when read at the observation, it yields a provable lower bound on the optimal value of the acquiring action, which floors its TD target and attributes this floor to the observation that earned it. Read at the decision, it defines the optimal retrieval set. A pilot retrieval system, to be trained and improved with this signal, solves a memory task with reduced context.
tldr: Proposes using the value of information, estimated from archived rollouts with a learned world model, to jointly enable cheap memory retrieval and credit assignment in RL, with provable bounds on the optimal value of memory-acquiring actions.
tldr_zh: 提出利用信息价值（通过从存档轨迹中学习的世界模型估计）来同时实现RL中廉价记忆检索与信用分配，并对记忆获取动作的最优价值给出可证明下界。

title: A Conveyor Belt Mechanism for Repositionable Magnetic Coupling Between Continuum Robots
summary: This work proposes a novel conveyor belt mechanism enabling continuous, active repositioning of functional elements along the body of a tendon-driven continuum robot. Up to three conveyor belt mechanisms are integrated within a 9 mm diameter continuum robot. We demonstrate equivalent or reduced conveyor belt actuation forces compared to robot tendon actuation forces. As a case study, we mount permanent magnets along two conveyor belts, and demonstrate actively reconfigurable inter-robot coupling. Coupling point location and quantity can be adjusted during robot operation to actively tune the effective stiffness of the coupled multi-robot system. We show that effective stiffness follows a predictable inverse-cubic relationship with coupling location, and increases with the number of coupling points. These findings demonstrate that the conveyor belt mechanism enables active functional element repositioning for changing tasks requirements, with magnetic inter-robot coupling as one proof-of-concept.
tldr: This paper introduces a conveyor belt mechanism for continuously repositioning functional elements along continuum robot bodies, demonstrating reconfigurable magnetic inter-robot coupling that tunes effective stiffness.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种传送带机制，可在连续体机器人本体上连续重新定位功能元件，并通过可重构的磁耦合调整多机器人系统的有效刚度。

title: The Athlete as a Scientist of One: Agentic Bayesian Experimental Design for Individualized Physiology from Consumer Wearables
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents for personal health read wearable data and recommend, but do not learn about the individual in a way that can be audited or falsified. We present EpiCoach, an agentic system that treats one athlete, a cross-country mountain biker, as the subject of accountable N-of-1 science. Claims about the athlete live in an evidence-gated hypothesis registry: each must issue a probabilistic prediction about a future session before it occurs, and its belief moves only through computed evidence from a logged statistical fit. Predictions come from a mechanistic digital twin inferred from heart rate, GPS and barometric altitude: a lagged heart-rate response model, a fitness-fatigue model with learned time constants, and a latent technical-descending skill state, measured on discovered trail segments. The agent prescribes the next training week as a constrained experiment maximizing information gain subject to load and safety constraints, around two instrument rides. We evaluate the system two ways over eighteen months of data. A rolling-origin replay benchmark shows the twin beats standard forecasters on heart rate but not segment time, and the agentic loop matches a static model. A live prospective phase runs the weekly cycle: in its first three weeks the ledger sealed 20 predictions, scored 14, the descent forecast calibrated after one correction, the climb forecast pessimistic as the athlete improved, and the safety officer vetoed the agent twice. Every correction is preserved in the registry, a template for auditable, falsifiable personalization in digital health. We release the registry, benchmark and protocol.
tldr: This paper presents EpiCoach, an agentic LLM system that uses Bayesian experimental design to personalize physiology modeling for a single athlete from wearable sensor data, building an auditable and falsifiable hypothesis registry and digital twin for training prescription.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了EpiCoach，一个基于LLM的代理系统，利用贝叶斯实验设计从可穿戴传感器数据中为单个运动员个性化生理建模，构建可审计、可证伪的假设注册表和数字孪生以制定训练计划。

title: AFast Robot Localization Method Based on Monte Carlo Sampling
summary: Localization is an essential capability of intelligent robots. However, in real-world constrained environments, robots often cannot rely on external localization systems. Therefore, this paper proposes an online particle-filter localization method based on Monte Carlo sampling. The method is applied to the localization of a mobile robot in a maze environment and requires only four range sensors mounted on the front, rear, left, and right sides of the vehicle, without the need for any heading information. Simulation experiments demonstrate that even in a maze where local regions are highly similar, the vehicle can still achieve relatively accurate localization, thereby providing a fast and effective approach for robot localization in complex environments.
tldr: This paper proposes an online particle-filter (Monte Carlo) localization method for a mobile robot in a maze, using only four range sensors and no heading information, and demonstrates accurate localization via simulation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种基于蒙特卡洛采样的在线粒子滤波定位方法，仅使用车辆前后左右四个测距传感器且无需航向信息，在迷宫环境中通过仿真实验实现了较准确的移动机器人定位。

title: AI for Science in Space: Orbital Laboratories, Planetary Fieldwork, and Embodied Autonomy
summary: Artificial intelligence for science (AI4S) is extending from interpretation of existing data to the design and execution of experiments. Space offers distinctive scientific opportunities while restricting physical support. Microgravity and extraterrestrial environments expose phenomena that terrestrial experiments cannot fully reproduce; finite samples, constrained resources, and limited opportunities for intervention complicate sustained investigation. This critical review examines orbital laboratories and planetary in situ science across biology, materials, fluid and thermal physics, and adaptive exploration. We distinguish learning from space-derived data, selecting scientific actions, executing them, and preserving experimental validity. Terrestrial self-driving laboratories provide complementary evidence on optimization, dedicated automation, robotic manipulation, and the support needed for unattended operation. The synthesis connects scientific gains already demonstrated by bounded AI systems to gaps in observation, executable actions, and continuity of valid evidence. Space robots can expand the attainable scope of autonomous science when necessary interventions exceed validated instrument capabilities and timely human support is unavailable. Their value must be established against dedicated mechanisms, redundancy, and human-supported operation. We develop a framework connecting sample history, scientific decisions, physical execution, and claim-specific validity. A worked orbital design, a planetary extension, and matched evaluation schemes separate the contributions of sensing, decision policies, and physical actions. The resulting agenda measures autonomy through valid scientific return, task coverage, intervention costs, and evidence integrity across complete campaigns.
tldr: This paper presents a critical review and framework for applying AI for science in space, focusing on orbital laboratories and planetary fieldwork, and evaluates the role of embodied autonomy and robotic systems in autonomous scientific experimentation.
tldr_zh: 本文对太空科学中的人工智能应用进行了批判性回顾和框架构建，重点关注轨道实验室和行星现场工作，并评估了具身自主和机器人系统在自主科学实验中的作用。

title: Actuator-Aware Observer Inputs for Cascade ADRC of Quadrotors Under Rotor Lag, Measurement Delay and Sensor Noise
summary: In sampled cascade linear active disturbance rejection control (LADRC) of quadrotors, the extended-state observer typically receives the instantaneous command, although the delayed measurement reflects an earlier, rotor-filtered acceleration. This paper proposes actuator-aware (AA) observer inputs: altitude and attitude observers use limited virtual inputs filtered by an assumed rotor model and aligned with the measurement delay, and horizontal observers use acceleration reconstructed from measured attitude. Fixed gains are selected on the discrete-time model under sensitivity and step-response requirements and stationary covariance ceilings on each channel's control variance and increment and on the noise-induced inner-loop increment of the full cascade. In paired set-point trials, PID-Budget, AA-Budget and AA-HalfGain reach mean RMSEs of 65.5, 19.2 and 16.9~mm; under a stricter common cascade ceiling, the AA designs reach 29.9 and 26.4~mm versus 72.3~mm for a PID that uses roughly double their rotor-command increment. PX4 software-in-the-loop runs reproduce these results. Behind EKF2, a noise model fitted to the estimation errors predicts the roll/pitch and yaw increments within 5\% on held-out and out-of-sample runs and the total rotor-command increment within 14\%. Redesigned for this stack under the same sensitivity and response specification and estimator-aware ceilings, AA-Budget-E reduces the set-point RMSE from 59.1~mm (PID-E) to 44.0~mm with a lower rotor-command increment in every paired set-point and lemniscate run (mean S6 rotor-command-increment reductions relative to PID-E: 45\% before and 15\% after output quantization); AA-HalfGain-E beats PID-E only on the lemniscate. The evidence is simulation-based, and the ceilings are nominal tuning constraints.
tldr: This paper proposes actuator-aware observer inputs for cascade linear ADRC of quadrotors, improving set-point accuracy and robustness under rotor lag, measurement delay, and sensor noise, validated through simulation and PX4 software-in-the-loop.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于四旋翼级联线性ADRC的执行器感知观测器输入方法，在旋翼滞后、测量延迟和传感器噪声下提高了设定点精度和鲁棒性，并通过仿真和PX4软件在环验证。

title: Algebraic World Model: From Exploration to Proofs
summary: AI has made remarkable progress in mathematics, solving challenging problems with machine-checkable proofs in Lean, yet typically relying on predefined mathematical definitions and formal specifications. This raises a natural question: can it reason rigorously about an unknown world? We introduce the Algebraic World Model (AWM), a framework that turns interaction with unfamiliar environments into explicit mathematical models supporting formal reasoning. AWM explores the environment and develops executable Python hypotheses, continually testing and revising them against observations. It then structures these hypotheses into typed objects and shared rules, simplifies their structure through category-theory-guided transformations, and formalizes the resulting model in Lean 4 to prove reachability and impossibility. AWM can formally prove that a goal is unreachable, even beyond explored trajectories. On two impossible game levels, it constructs closed, kernel-checked Lean proofs excluding every legal winning sequence in all six runs, while Claude Opus 5.5 and GPT-6 Astra, equipped with coding tools, produce none in twelve baseline runs. Four of AWM's six initial bounds are correct, compared with one for Opus 5.5 and none for GPT-6 Astra; given only feedback that a cheaper win exists, AWM revises its rules and constructs new proofs, reaching six of six correct bounds. Moreover, AWM produces interpretable mathematical models whose rules can be inspected and tested step by step. Across all 25 public ARC-AGI-3 games, these models enable Lean to replay the winning trajectories of all 183 levels and generalize beyond observed play, predicting unseen transitions and detecting changes in game mechanics. With Claude Opus 5, AWM clears all levels with a score of 99.9, while its certified winning trajectories use only 43% of the human baseline's actions.
tldr: AWM introduces a framework that explores unknown environments to build formal mathematical models, using category-theory-guided simplification and Lean 4 proofs to verify reachability and impossibility, validated on impossible game levels and ARC-AGI-3 games.
tldr_zh: AWM 提出一个框架，通过探索未知环境构建形式化数学模型，并利用范畴论指导的简化和 Lean 4 证明来验证可达性和不可达性，在不可能游戏关卡和 ARC-AGI-3 游戏中得到验证。

title: Fight World Model: Customizable Combat through Visual Interaction Proxies
summary: A playable, programmable game world must maintain persistent state, enforce executable rules, and support extensible gameplay mechanics. Existing video world models can generate plausible combat, yet struggle to keep hit reactions and health updates consistent with game rules. We introduce Fight World Model (FWM), which separates rule-governed combat execution from video rendering. An executable engine maintains state and resolves interactions. A deterministic compiler encodes these outcomes and attempted actions in a spatially and temporally aligned interaction proxy. The proxy aligns action and skill windows, brief hit reactions, and persistent health by fighter identity and timing. These cues can be controlled separately to render interactions under modified rules. Identity-bound references preserve character appearance across side switches. We train FWM on FightWorld Corpus, spanning 52 skill effects, 187 character-appearance variants, and 15 arenas. Without retraining the renderer, FWM supports damage scaling, limited-hit immunity, lifesteal, and multi-stage skill mechanisms beyond the native game. It also allows character and arena customization. Experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of FWM, which outperforms existing game world models in action fidelity, hit reactions, health-state consistency, and character appearance preservation. Our project is available at https://fight-world-model.github.io.
tldr: FWM separates executable rule engine from video rendering for game combat, using deterministic interaction proxies to align action/hit/health states and enable customizable combat rules without retraining the renderer, trained on a new FightWorld Corpus.
tldr_zh: FWM 将可执行规则引擎与视频渲染分离，通过确定性交互代理对齐动作/受击/血量状态，无需重新训练渲染器即可支持自定义战斗规则，并在新 FightWorld 语料库上训练。

title: Wizard: Manipulate Any World in Real Time via Agentic Control
summary: Recent advances in video world models have enabled the generation of increasingly realistic and interactive virtual environments, opening new possibilities for player-customizable gameplay. Agentic frameworks further advance this direction by decoupling explicit game logic and controllable world representations from visual generation. However, existing approaches support only simple game settings and predefined motion patterns, generalize poorly to unseen environments and characters, and offer limited real-time interactivity. In this paper, we introduce Wizard, an agentic game world model that enables real-time, precise control over character motions while generalizing zero-shot across novel scenes, characters, and actions. To achieve this, we construct a diverse dataset spanning 750 scenes and 178 characters, incorporating skeleton and geometry information as structured representations. We leverage these representations as intermediate proxies to condition a video generation model, together with an adaptive masking mechanism that improves alignment between the conditioning signals and generated video rollouts. Furthermore, we introduce an agentic framework that explicitly maintains and updates game states, allowing players to freely configure their virtual worlds and exercise fine-grained control over character motions while preserving visual quality and gameplay consistency. By combining agentic control with structured proxy-based generation, our framework unlocks new possibilities for player-driven game creation with real-time, generalizable, and mechanically consistent world simulation.
tldr: Wizard is an agentic game world model that enables real-time, precise character motion control while generalizing zero-shot across novel scenes, characters, and actions using structured skeleton and geometry proxies to condition a video generation model.
tldr_zh: Wizard 是一个智能体游戏世界模型，通过结构化的骨骼与几何代理条件化视频生成模型，实现对角色动作的实时精确控制，并能零样本泛化到新场景、角色和动作。

title: Fundamental Limits of Sampling-Based Reachability: Geometry and Flow Distortion
summary: Sampling-based reachability estimates reachable sets from finitely many simulated trajectory endpoints. Existing guarantees often control missed probability mass or approximation error relative to the convex hull of the reachable set, leaving the geometric error relative to the reachable set incompletely characterized. We study this error as a problem of support estimation under flow distortion. Our assumptions combine a uniform lower bound on the local volume density of the initial set, a lower bound on the sampling density, and a one-sided Lipschitz constant $μ$ for the vector field. These conditions admit initial sets with corners and dynamics that may expand or contract. In the fine-accuracy regime, $\tilde{\mathcal O}\bigl(2^ne^{nμT}(R/r)^n/(ρκ)\bigr)$ independent endpoint samples suffice for Hausdorff accuracy $r$ using the endpoint cloud. Here, $n$ is the state dimension, $T$ is the horizon, $R$ is the volume-equivalent radius, and $ρ$ and $κ$ quantify sampling density and local volume density. For $n\ge2$ and sufficiently small $κ$, a minimax lower bound over all estimators based only on independent endpoints matches these dependencies up to a dimension-dependent factor $2\cdot4^n$ and logarithmic factors, within the stated parameter range and when the state domain accommodates the construction. The exponential burden in dimension, and in the horizon for expanding systems, is therefore intrinsic to this observation model. Planar experiments illustrate the predicted effects of corners and contraction; robot-arm experiments show how empirical accuracy deteriorates with dimension.
tldr: This paper provides theoretical guarantees and minimax lower bounds for sampling-based reachable set estimation under flow distortion, showing exponential dependence on dimension and horizon is intrinsic.
tldr_zh: 本文对基于采样的可达集估计在流畸变下的理论保证和极小极大下界进行了研究，表明维度和时间范围上的指数依赖是内在的。

title: socx: GPU-Accelerated Chance-Constrained Stochastic Optimal Control using JAX
summary: In this article, we present socx, a GPU-accelerated solver for lifted convex reformulations of linear stochastic optimal control under chance constraints, implemented in JAX. We demonstrate that by exploiting the sparse and independent structure of the problem, distributed optimization can reduce it to simpler problems: independent linear-quadratic tracking (LQT) problems and Euclidean projections onto sets. These simpler problems can be solved in parallel and then coupled using the constraints. To validate our solver, we run it on a hover-linearized 3D quadrotor and show a speed-up of up to $98\times$ over MOSEK and up to $2224\times$ over SCS. socx also solves horizons up to $N=1120$, whereas MOSEK runs out of memory at $N=320$. We present ablations to isolate the key components that enable the speed-up.
tldr: This paper presents socx, a GPU-accelerated JAX solver for chance-constrained stochastic optimal control, demonstrating significant speedups over existing solvers on a quadrotor control problem.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了socx，一个基于JAX的GPU加速求解器，用于处理机会约束随机最优控制问题，并在四旋翼控制问题上展示了比现有求解器显著的加速效果。

title: Securing the Robotics Supply Chain
summary: This paper sets out what a sustained federal research and investment agenda would need to include to close that gap--not within a single budget cycle, but over the decade such an undertaking will realistically require. It identifies where the gap is most pronounced today: in the methods needed to verify and certify components of uncertain origin, in the foundational hardware research that has long been underfunded relative to software, in the physical infrastructure researchers need to test systems at scale, and in the workforce required to build and sustain all of it. Robotics should not be treated merely as a downstream beneficiary of a broader artificial intelligence investment strategy. It constitutes its own supply chain, with its own points of failure, and merits its own sustained federal commitment.
tldr: This paper advocates for a sustained federal research and investment agenda to secure the robotics supply chain, addressing verification, hardware research, test infrastructure, and workforce needs beyond a single budget cycle.
tldr_zh: 本文主张为保障机器人供应链安全，制定一项持续性的联邦研究与投资议程，以解决验证、硬件研究、测试基础设施和劳动力需求，而非仅限单个预算周期内。

title: Data-Driven or Model-Constrained? Comparing Airflow Estimation Methods under Sparse Sensing
summary: Airflow-driven advection is the primary mechanism for gas and aerosol dispersion in real-world scenarios, making accurate airflow estimation essential for ventilation monitoring, gas source localization, and contaminant spread analysis. Since obtaining airflow maps via high-resolution spatial sensing is usually infeasible in practice, flow field estimation methods must cope with sparse measurements by introducing statistical or physical priors to compensate for limited data. Existing approaches mainly differ in how they incorporate fluid-flow constraints and environmental geometry. However, due to the lack of systematic comparisons across this spectrum of methods, the potential benefits of physics-based priors for airflow estimation under sparse sensing remain underexplored. To address this question, we quantitatively evaluate four airflow estimators across three simulated 2D scenarios under steady-state conditions and varying sampling densities. The methods range from Gaussian Process Regression and graph-based Gaussian Markov Random Fields to two Navier-Stokes-based approaches, including a novel strong-form residual minimization variant. Our results show that physical priors provide the greatest benefit at low sampling densities by compensating for missing spatial information. Although data-driven Gaussian Process Regression becomes increasingly competitive as sensor coverage increases, model-based estimators retain an accuracy advantage across the evaluated scenarios.
tldr: This paper compares four airflow estimation methods under sparse sensing, showing that physics-based Navier-Stokes priors offer the greatest benefit at low sampling densities while data-driven Gaussian Process Regression becomes competitive as sensor coverage increases.
tldr_zh: 本文比较了四种在稀疏传感条件下的气流估计方法，表明基于物理的Navier-Stokes先验在低采样密度时优势最大，而数据驱动的高斯过程回归在传感器覆盖率增加时变得具有竞争力。

title: Smartphone Indoor Localization Enhanced by Hierarchical Multi-Sensor Context Recognition
summary: Smartphone indoor localization requires low-cost, robust positioning across scene transitions and phone-use variations. Pedestrian dead reckoning (PDR) enables infrastructure-free deployment but accumulates errors from heading drift, structural transitions, and carrying-mode changes. Existing methods often treat contextual cues as a single event stream or local correction signal, limiting their ability to address distinct localization errors. This paper presents a framework enhanced by hierarchical multi-sensor context recognition. A jointly data- and model-driven recognition model predicts environment, scene, and activity probabilities, which are converted into scene-event and action-context segments. Scene-event segments guide scene-constrained PDR correction through corridor heading constraints, landmark attraction, fixed-lag backtracking, and vertical-transition handling. Action-context segments drive action-aware RoNIN-based position compensation for carrying-mode-dependent drift. Experiments on cross-floor and multi-action trajectories against LiDAR-SLAM references show that the proposed framework outperforms PDR and representative learned inertial odometry baselines, demonstrating that hierarchical semantics provide reliable, localization-specific correction cues.
tldr: This paper presents a smartphone indoor localization framework that enhances pedestrian dead reckoning with hierarchical multi-sensor context recognition, using scene and action context cues to correct drift and improve positioning accuracy.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种智能手机室内定位框架，通过层次化多传感器上下文识别增强行人航位推算，利用场景和动作上下文提示修正漂移并提高定位精度。

title: Kairos: Semantics-Aware Orchestration of Planning Engines across Classical, Numeric, Temporal and Hybrid PDDL
summary: Planning at run time, as in robots that re-plan while they act, needs a planner that reads the PDDL its users write (durative actions, numeric resources, time windows, continuous change), answers quickly, and delivers only validated plans. Specialised planners are strong on individual fragments of PDDL, but they differ in coverage, latency and in what their failures mean. We study whether selecting heterogeneous engines from the semantics of each task can give broad coverage of PDDL, from STRIPS to PDDL+, while remaining competitive with specialised planners and making explicit what each answer guarantees. Kairos profiles each task to decide which of five engines apply (ground heuristic search, compressed and snap-action temporal search, time steps for hybrid dynamics, lifted search) and schedules them under one budget of time and memory. Every candidate plan is checked by a validator independent of the planner's transformations, and "unsolvable" is reported only when a search whose exhaustion is a proof exhausts its space. On 1,756 tasks from nine comparative suites, Kairos solves more tasks at the full limits than the strongest evaluated planner of each suite, with the largest differences on numeric, temporal, PDDL3 and PDDL+ planning, and it also solves the most tasks at 100 ms and 1 s. Resampling over domains, the gain is above zero in six of the nine suites, while on classical planning against LAMA it is within the noise. A further 450 feature-oriented tasks and 26 one-feature probes show that Kairos handles all seventeen features probed, where no other planner evaluated handles more than eight. Ablations identify compressed temporal search and the novelty fallback as major contributors, and a comparison with VAL traces every disagreement to a PDDL+ convention or to a documented VAL defect. Planner and benchmark are open source.
tldr: Kairos is a semantics-aware orchestration framework that selects among five heterogeneous PDDL planners based on task features to achieve broad coverage across classical, numeric, temporal, and hybrid planning. It solves more tasks than specialized planners and validates every plan with an independent checker.
tldr_zh: Kairos 是一个语义感知的规划引擎编排框架，根据任务特征在五种异构 PDDL 规划器间进行选择，以实现经典、数值、时序和混合规划任务的广泛覆盖。它在基准任务上超过专用规划器，并用独立校验器验证每个规划结果。

title: Selective Sliding Mode Control Enhances Robustness of Aerial Robots Under Disturbances
summary: Quadrotor control under disturbances such as wind gusts and payload variations remains challenging. First-order sliding mode control (SMC) and matched/unmatched uncertainty distinction are classical approaches; however, neither tells a practitioner which loops in a cascaded controller should be made robust to sustain disturbances, how to tune those loops, nor what the additional costs are on an embedded processor. Applying robust control uniformly across all axes addresses disturbances indiscriminately, adding tuning effort on axes where no disturbance acts. On inherently underactuated vehicles, disturbances along some axes cannot be opposed directly at all. We propose a principled methodology for deciding where robust control belongs in a cascaded architecture, with all control running onboard the vehicle. We recover the acting disturbance from PID hover flights under disturbance by inverting the equations of motion, use the recovered signal to identify and quantify the excited axes, and deploy robust control where it counts. Experiments on a Crazyflie 2.1 quadrotor under slung-payload and oblique-wind disturbances show tracking improvements concentrated on the axes the rule selects, and gain sweeps confirm that the switching gain reduces error on matched axes but has no effect on an excited unmatched axis, as the analysis predicts.
tldr: Proposes a methodology for selectively applying sliding mode control only to the axes in a cascaded quadrotor controller that are actually excited by disturbances, validated on a Crazyflie 2.1 under slung-payload and wind disturbances.
tldr_zh: 提出一种方法，仅对四旋翼级联控制器中实际受扰动的轴选择性应用滑模控制，并在Crazyflie 2.1上通过吊挂负载和斜风扰动实验验证。

title: Certified Access: Test-Time Compute on Conservative Physics-Structured AI Memory
summary: Test-time compute mechanisms, such as retries, confidence-based escalation and non-local routing, are conventionally deployed as black-box additions to trained models. They typically add forward passes or halting heads, but give no structural account of what the extra compute buys or what it costs against the model's stability guarantees. We therefore propose a theoretical and empirical framework for test-time compute on a Latent Dynamics Model used as the memory. When an encoder's latent state $(q,p)$ is advanced by a damped symplectic (velocity-Verlet) step of a learned Hamiltonian, every mechanism that expands access has an exact phase-volume Jacobian, a bounded energy change and an exact latch-transport law. We split reachability failures into escape failures and reach failures. A Lorentz squeeze resolves escape failures by injecting bounded, re-absorbable energy. A gated canonical translation (a one-step channel across $C_T$) resolves reach failures at $\detJ=1$ exactly. We verify this certificate stack on a designed analytic testbed. Reaching just beyond $C_T$ with the squeeze requires energy that grows quadratically in the excess distance. The gated channel's energy cost equals the potential difference between its endpoints, which is zero on the matched channel measured here, and so does not grow with distance in this testbed. An untrained state-replacing map annihilates phase volume and erases stored charge, while the gated channel transports it. On a learned physics-structured memory, we show calibrated compute rationing and evaluate the scaling limits of non-local routing against a physics-free baseline. The main contribution is the formalization and verification of the certificate stack, not benchmark performance.
tldr: This paper proposes a theoretical and empirical framework for test-time compute on a Latent Dynamics Model, introducing a certificate stack with exact phase-volume Jacobians, bounded energy changes, and latch-transport laws, verified on analytic testbeds.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种在潜在动力学模型上进行测试时计算的理论和实证框架，引入了具有精确相体积雅可比、有界能量变化和锁存传输定律的证书堆栈，并在解析测试平台上进行了验证。

title: CAD-WAM: Anticipating Geometry for Text-to-CAD Generation
summary: Generating editable computer-aided design (CAD) models from text requires selecting operations that produce the intended changes to the geometry constructed so far. An incorrect operation can compromise subsequent steps, making reliable multi-step generation challenging. Existing methods based on large language models (LLMs) primarily learn to predict commands, without explicit supervision of the geometric states those commands should produce. Inspired by world-action models, we introduce CAD-WAM, which couples geometry-conditioned action generation with next-state prediction. We define complete modeling operations as actions in a CAD domain-specific language (DSL) and encode surface point clouds of intermediate solids into compact latent states using a pretrained variational autoencoder. An LLM backbone generates the next action from the target description and current geometric state, while an auxiliary head on the same backbone predicts the next state to provide geometric supervision during training. We construct step-wise training trajectories from parametric CAD models in the DeepCAD dataset, pairing each trajectory with an expert-level textual description. At inference, each generated action is executed by a CAD kernel, and the resulting solid is re-encoded to inform the next decision. On the DeepCAD test set, CAD-WAM outperforms the task-specific baselines in geometric accuracy and output validity, with larger gains on models requiring more operations, and produces more accurate geometry than general-purpose LLMs prompted with the same DSL. Ablations further show that next-state supervision reduces mean Chamfer distance by 13.2\% relative to an otherwise identical model trained only to predict actions. Code is available at https://github.com/Lzy-1037/CAD-WAM.
tldr: CAD-WAM couples geometry-conditioned action generation with next-state prediction for text-to-CAD, using an LLM backbone to generate CAD DSL actions and an auxiliary head to predict latent geometric states, improving geometric accuracy and validity on the DeepCAD benchmark.
tldr_zh: CAD-WAM 将几何条件动作生成与下一状态预测相结合，用于文本到 CAD 生成，利用 LLM 主干生成 CAD DSL 动作，并通过辅助头预测潜在几何状态，在 DeepCAD 基准上提高了几何精度和有效性。

title: Limit Theorems and Optimal Policies for Flock Flight through Poisson Forests
summary: Inspired by birds flying through cluttered environments, Karaman and Frazzoli showed that high-speed flight through an ergodic random forest exhibits an ultimate speed limit: above a critical speed, almost surely no infinite collision-free trajectory exists for a single bird. This paper formulates a corresponding bulk-transport problem for many birds. We construct an explicit directed corridor network in a Poisson disk forest and impose a common temporal headway at its waypoints. The maximum current equals a minimum vertex-cut capacity and is achieved by repeated flight along vertex-disjoint paths. The same schedule maximizes completed traversals at every finite horizon, with constant forward speed and no internal waiting. For a forest belt of fixed depth, exact transverse superadditivity yields an almost-sure deterministic current-density limit. A uniform shape theorem for an asymmetric planar dual identifies the current when depth and width grow together. For diverging depth bounded by a constant times width, this current equals the width-first, depth-second limit and is independent of the positive aspect ratio. When diagonal corridors are available, bulk current is positive at sufficiently low obstacle intensity and zero at sufficiently high intensity. For stochastic demand, an upstream admission queue is stable at every rate below the finite-network capacity.
tldr: The paper formulates a bulk-transport problem for many birds flying through a Poisson disk forest, constructing a directed corridor network with temporal headway to derive current-density limits and optimal policies, extending Karaman and Frazzoli's single-bird speed limit result.
tldr_zh: 本文将单鸟穿越随机森林的速度极限问题扩展为多鸟的批量运输问题，在泊松圆盘森林中构建有向走廊网络并施加时间间隔约束，推导出电流密度极限与最优飞行策略。

title: DYNAS: A Dynamic Network Penetration Testing Framework Using Deep Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning
summary: As network scale and uncertainty complicate automated penetration testing, reinforcement learning (RL) environments must support controlled evaluation under defensive and non-stationary conditions. We present DYNAS (Dynamic Network Attack Simulator), which combines parameterized large-scale scenario generation with stateful intrusion detection responses, explicit scan false-positive and false-negative noise, temporary service unavailability, and duration-based action timeouts. We further introduce Pen-DHRL, a recurrent manager--worker policy that selects persistent subgoals using IDS-conditioned global context. We compare Pen-DHRL with GNN, Invariant, and Attention baselines across four scenario variants and multiple training regimes. Under IDS-disabled training followed by IDS-enabled evaluation, Pen-DHRL obtains approximately 64\% and 24\% higher reward per step on Bridge and Dynamic, respectively, and approximately 26\% and 30\% more captured hosts on VarA and VarB than the next-best baseline. With all defensive dynamics active from the beginning of training, Pen-DHRL achieves positive mean episode returns in all four scenarios, whereas the flat baselines produce negative mean returns in all 12 architecture--scenario combinations; staged curriculum training produces positive mean returns across all 16 evaluated combinations.
tldr: DYNAS presents a dynamic network penetration testing framework using deep hierarchical reinforcement learning, with a recurrent manager-worker policy (Pen-DHRL) that performs well under adversarial and non-stationary network conditions.
tldr_zh: DYNAS提出了一种使用深度分层强化学习的动态网络渗透测试框架，其循环管理器-工作者策略（Pen-DHRL）在对抗性和非平稳网络条件下表现良好。

title: A 211K Parameter Foundation Model: Genetic Prompting in Neural Cellular Automata
summary: The scale of modern foundation models enables broad task generalization. In medical imaging, where segmentation demands vary widely across clinical contexts, such flexibility is invaluable. But current models, such as SAM trade adaptability for scale, locking their utility behind high-end infrastructure and leaving behind the low-resource environments most in need of diagnostic support. To bridge this gap, we introduce Foundational-NCA, a lightweight foundation model capable of adapting to a wide range of medical segmentation tasks without retraining.
